articles.src: 2026年河南中考
articles.title: “Why is the sky blue?
body: “Why is the sky blue?” “Why do we add sugar to food?” “Why…?”
Everyone knew 10-year-old Ananya as “the question girl”.
“Ananya, stop asking so many questions!” her teacher Mrs. Sharma would say. “Just accept things as they are,” her grandmother told her. “She talks too much,” her classmates avoided her.
Ananya felt lonely. Maybe everyone was right. Maybe asking questions was bad. But Ananya couldn’t help it. She wanted to understand everything.

One day, Mr. Patel, a new science teacher, joined their school. In his first class, Ananya raised her hand, “Why do birds fly south?” The class complained (抱怨), “Not again!” But Mr. Patel smiled, “That’s an excellent question! Who else wants to know why?” Ananya blinked (眨眼) in surprise. No teacher had ever said that before!

After class, Mr. Patel called Ananya aside. “Don’t ever stop asking questions,” he said. “Do you know what scientists do all day? They ask ‘why’. Every scientist was once a curious child.” For the first time, Ananya didn’t feel annoyed (烦恼的). She felt special.
Mr. Patel taught Ananya to find answers herself. “When you have a question, first try to find the answer. Read books. Watch carefully. Then, if you still don’t understand, ask.”
Ananya started visiting the library. She read books about science and nature. She started a “Question Notebook”.
[图:reading/de9562ce/image7.png]
Her questions became better. Instead of “Why is the sky blue?” she asked “Why does the sky’s color change during sunrise?” Teachers noticed. Ananya’s questions now sparked interesting discussions.

When Ananya was twelve, she had a question: “Why do some street dogs sleep on the road at night?” She studied that for three months. Then she created a project showing temperature differences. It won first prize at school, then district, then national level!

Today, Ananya is 24 and studies environmental science. She still asks “why” all the time. She visits schools, talking to children. “Never let anyone make you feel bad for being curious,” she tells them.

qs.stem: Why did Ananya’s classmates avoid her?
opts: Because she didn’t like to talk with others.
Because she kept asking so many questions.
Because she always got into trouble with others.
Because she couldn’t answer teachers’ questions.

ex.ev: “She talks too much,” her classmates avoided her.
ex.why: 大家都嫌她问题太多（第一段一连串的 Why），同学躲着她是因为她总是问个不停。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “curious” mean in the text?

ex.ev: Every scientist was once a curious child.
ex.why: 科学家整天问「为什么」，每个科学家小时候都是 curious 的孩子——curious 就是「好奇的、想知道」。

qs.stem: What did Mr. Patel do to help Ananya?
opts: He taught her some social skills.
He created a project with her.
He bought a lot of books for her.
He encouraged her to ask wisely.

ex.ev: “When you have a question, first try to find the answer. Read books. Watch carefully. Then, if you still don’t understand, ask.”
ex.why: Patel 老师让她先自己找答案、看书、观察，弄不懂再问——是鼓励她会提问，而不是不问。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be put in    #   ?
opts: How I became a good student
Why I had to take notes
Where I found the real answer

ex.ev: She read books about science and nature. She started a “Question Notebook”.
ex.why: 图里的本子是她的「问题本」，记的是她自己找到的答案，C「我在哪里找到真正的答案」最合适。

qs.stem: What can be learned from the story?
opts: Every question is a door opening.
Be thankful for what you have.

ex.ev: “Never let anyone make you feel bad for being curious,” she tells them.
ex.why: 她的问题越问越好，最后拿了全国一等奖，还在学环境科学——每个问题都是一扇打开的门。

cand: adj. 好奇的；求知欲强的
adj. 自然环境的；环保的

articles.src: 2026年河南中考
articles.title: Did you notice how nature sometimes repeats itself?
body: Did you notice how nature sometimes repeats itself? Something that repeats is called a pattern. There are many patterns for you to study and learn.

Look around you. Patterns are everywhere. You may see bright and colorful patterns if you look at fish in the sea. In a bee’s honeycomb, the six-sided shape is repeated many times. Some leaves always have five points on them.
[图:reading/de9562ce/image8.jpeg]

Listening carefully, you will find a noisy world. Dogs bark, the rain falls and the wind blows. Are these patterns? Of course! Sounds that repeat are patterns. A cricket (蟋蟀) uses its wings to make repeated chirping (啁啾叫) sounds. Do you know that a cricket’s chirp changes with the temperature? The hotter it is, the more chirps a cricket will make.

Try to find out how living things grow around you. Seeds (种子) grow into plants. A butterfly begins life as an egg. Each living thing has its own pattern as it grows. When a human baby is born, it is small. With time, the baby learns to lift its head and learns to roll over. Finally, the baby learns to stand up and walk. This kind of pattern is called a pattern of development.

If something happens over and over, it, too, forms a pattern. For example, you get up at 7:00 every morning. You get dressed and then eat breakfast at 7:30 a.m. If you repeat this many times, it becomes a pattern. Having a music class every Monday is a pattern. So is going to school five days a week and having Saturday and Sunday off.
It seems as if the world is full of patterns. Just think — without patterns, the world would be much harder to study!

qs.stem: What makes the pattern in a bee’s honeycomb?

ex.ev: In a bee’s honeycomb, the six-sided shape is repeated many times.
ex.why: 蜂巢里重复的是六边形这个形状。

qs.stem: What is Paragraph 3 mainly about?

ex.ev: Sounds that repeat are patterns.
ex.why: 第三段讲狗叫、下雨、风声、蟋蟀叫——都是能听到的规律。

qs.stem: Which picture shows “a pattern of development”?

ex.ev: With time, the baby learns to lift its head and learns to roll over. Finally, the baby learns to stand up and walk.
ex.why: 「成长规律」是生物一步步长大的过程，D 图画的是宝宝从抬头、翻身到站起来走路。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “it” in Paragraph 5 refer to?
opts: Going to school five days a week.

ex.ev: If something happens over and over, it, too, forms a pattern.
ex.why: it 就在同一句里，指前面的 something that happens over and over（反复发生的事）。

qs.stem: What is the writer’s purpose in writing the text?
opts: To discuss when patterns were found.
To explain why patterns are beautiful.
To show the difficulty of studying patterns.

ex.ev: There are many patterns for you to study and learn.
ex.why: 全文介绍看得到、听得到的规律、成长规律和生活中的规律，目的是分享关于规律的知识。

articles.src: 2026年河南中考
articles.title: Have you ever heard of the word “spring-cleaning”?
body: Have you ever heard of the word “spring-cleaning”? Humans have been doing this for quite a long time to welcome brighter days with fresh beginnings.
36    Humans are part of nature. When trees grow new leaves and birds build their nests in spring, people feel it is a good time to say goodbye to unwanted things and freshen up their rooms.

Spring-cleaning is good for you in lots of ways. When spring arrives, you naturally have more energy. Like any exercise, tidying gets you moving and improves your mood (心情).    37    Also, cleaning as a family brings everyone closer because you’re working together. When your room is clean, you feel proud of yourself and look forward to having fun in it.

38    Start by clearing one place at a time, like a table, drawer or corner of a room. Put everything into a group, then sort (将……分类) them into smaller groups of things you want to keep, sell, donate (捐赠) or throw away. The best way to tidy up is to make it fun. You can turn it into a game by setting a timer and seeing how many things you can put away before it runs out.    39

People around the world do spring-cleaning. During the Songkran Festival in Thailand, people clean their homes and splash water in the streets to wash away bad luck.    40    It is believed that “sweeping the dust (灰尘)” makes way for good luck.

opts: But how can you do some spring-cleaning?
Putting some music on while cleaning is a way, too.
Why do people give everything a good clean in spring?
Chinese New Year starts with a spring-cleaning day called Sao Chen.
Throwing away old things can clear your mind and help you to relax.

36.ev: Humans are part of nature. When trees grow new leaves and birds build their nests in spring, people feel it is a good time to say goodbye to unwanted things and freshen up their rooms.
36.why: 后面解释人们春天大扫除的原因，所以空格处先提问：C「人们为什么要在春天大扫除？」

37.ev: Like any exercise, tidying gets you moving and improves your mood (心情).
37.why: 这一段讲大扫除的好处：前一句说能改善心情，E「扔掉旧东西能让头脑清爽、放松」接着讲好处。

38.ev: Start by clearing one place at a time, like a table, drawer or corner of a room.
38.why: 这一段讲具体怎么打扫，所以开头先问：A「那么怎样大扫除呢？」

39.ev: The best way to tidy up is to make it fun. You can turn it into a game by setting a timer and seeing how many things you can put away before it runs out.
39.why: 前面说让打扫变好玩，比如定时比赛；B「打扫时放点音乐也是一种方法」接着补充，too 是提示。

40.ev: It is believed that “sweeping the dust (灰尘)” makes way for good luck.
40.why: 这一段讲世界各地的大扫除；后面「扫尘」带来好运，说的是中国，所以填 D「春节从扫尘日开始」。

cand: v. 使清新；使焕然一新

articles.src: 2025年河南中考
articles.title: “Stephen!” shouted Billy from the back of the class.
body: [图:reading/fb2bd0f8/image9.png]
“Stephen!” shouted Billy from the back of the class. “What’s 160 divided by 7?”
“22.85714,” replied Stephen without looking up.
“Good job!” said Billy, copying the number down in his notebook.
“Stephen! When is Thomas’s birthday?” asked Mary.
“It’s February 16,” said Stephen, “and he was born on a Tuesday.”
“Wow!” said Thomas. “How did you know that?”
“You told me,” said Stephen, “on November 5 last year, at 3:05 pm. It was nine months, three days, four hours and sixteen minutes ago...”
Carol cut in, “You did the calculation (计算) all in your head?”
“Yes, of course,” said Stephen. “How else would I have done it?”
Carol couldn’t believe her ears and almost fell off her chair.
“Wow!” said Thomas. “We have a real genius (天才) here. Right here, in our class!” He looked at Stephen and gave him a big smile.
Stephen turned bright red, like a tomato. “I am not a genius,” he said quietly. “I’m just Stephen.”
“But you’re so good at math and remembering things, surely you must be a genius,” said Thomas kindly.
“I can prove (证明) I’m not,” said Stephen.
He got up and started to collect things from his classmates: a painting, a geography notebook, a history notebook and an English notebook. Then he went to the front of the class.
“Tell me what you see,” Stephen said, holding up Carol’s painting.
“A really good picture!” shouted out Thomas.
Next Stephen picked out Thomas’s geography notebook. “Listen up,” he said. “Test 1, A+. Test 2, A+. Test 3, A+.”
“Good job!” Mary shouted.
“Now you, Mary,” said Stephen. “History project last term-teacher’s words: an excellent piece of work. History project last year-teacher’s words: excellent, good job, Mary.”
Stephen continued, “Now I’m going to read you a poem.” It was from Billy’s English notebook
“What a beautiful poem!” said Carol.
“And what a nice way to prove you’re not a genius,” said Thomas. “You just showed us that    ▲   , didn’t you?”
“I hope so,” said Stephen, and he went back to his desk without another word.

qs.stem: How was Stephen’s special ability shown at the beginning of the story?

ex.ev: “Stephen!” shouted Billy from the back of the class. “What’s 160 divided by 7?”
ex.why: 故事一开头，同学们轮流问 Stephen 问题（算数、生日），他马上答出来，这就是他的特殊本领。

qs.stem: How might Carol be feeling when she almost fell off the chair?

ex.ev: Carol couldn’t believe her ears and almost fell off her chair.
ex.why: 「不敢相信自己的耳朵」，差点从椅子上掉下来，说明她非常吃惊。

qs.stem: Which subject was Mary good at?

ex.ev: History project last term-teacher’s words: an excellent piece of work.
ex.why: Stephen 念的是 Mary 的历史作业，老师两次都评「优秀」，所以 Mary 擅长历史。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be put in    ▲   ?
opts: it’s very important to learn math well
it’s no use being a genius at all
we’re all geniuses in our special ways
we are much smarter than you

ex.ev: a painting, a geography notebook, a history notebook and an English notebook
ex.why: Stephen 一一展示：Carol 会画画，Thomas 地理好，Mary 历史好，Billy 会写诗——每个人都有自己擅长的，所以选 C。

qs.stem: What can we learn about Stephen?
opts: He was smart but not proud.
He was good at telling stories.
He was hard to get along with.
He was used to copying others.

ex.ev: “I am not a genius,” he said quietly. “I’m just Stephen.”
ex.why: 他算数、记忆都很厉害，却脸红说自己不是天才，还夸别人的长处——聪明但不骄傲。

cand: adj. 真实的；实际存在的

articles.src: 2025年河南中考
articles.title: Sunshine does make people happier.
body: [图:reading/fb2bd0f8/image10.png]
Sunshine does make people happier. Imagine how cheerful you are when it clears up after long cold rainy days. Let’s discover science behind sunlight.

Sunlight causes you to produce a chemical (化学物质) called serotonin (血清素). When you are exposed to sunlight, your body will make more serotonin. Higher levels of serotonin will keep you in good spirits. At night, when there is little or no light, your body produces another chemical-melatonin (褪黑激素). It helps your body relax and will make you feel tired, which can prepare you for a good night’s sleep. You should keep a good balance between these two chemicals.

However, for many people, it is hard to balance sunlight with darkness. People who stay indoors a lot may not get enough sunlight. The light in a house is usually about 100 times less than that outside on a sunny day. That’s why it is believed that those people should get outside in the sunshine. They can get some exercise, enjoy the fresh air and be happy, all at the same time.

There are places where it gets dark for a long time in the winter. People in those places are easier to get seasonal affective disorder (SAD). People with SAD usually go through bad experiences such as low energy and sadness. The most common treatment for those people is to sit under bright artificial (人工的) lights for some time.

The roles that sunshine plays in people’s life are more than those above. For example, your body produces Vitamin D (维生素D) from sunlight, which is important for being healthy. In fact, there is more science about sunlight for you to discover. So next time, when you notice the sunshine on your shoulder, take a moment to think, “Why do we love sunshine?”

qs.stem: Which of the following can take the place of “are exposed to” in the text?

ex.ev: When you are exposed to sunlight, your body will make more serotonin.
ex.why: be exposed to sunlight 意思是「待在阳光下、接触阳光」，可以换成 stay in。

qs.stem: What does Paragraph 2 mainly talk about?
opts: What can help people to keep in good spirits
How light influences people through chemicals.
Why melatonin can help people relax for a sleep.
Which chemical is thought to be more important.

ex.ev: Sunlight causes you to produce a chemical (化学物质) called serotonin (血清素).
ex.why: 第二段讲阳光让身体产生血清素、黑暗时产生褪黑激素——光是通过化学物质影响人的。

qs.stem: Which of the following is an opinion (观点) according to the text?
opts: There are places where it gets dark for a long time in the winter.
People who stay indoors a lot should get outside in the sunshine.
The light in a house is usually less than that outside on a sunny day.
People’s bodies produce something called Vitamin D from sunlight.

ex.ev: That’s why it is believed that those people should get outside in the sunshine.
ex.why: 「人们认为……应该到户外晒太阳」是一种看法（观点）；其他三项都是事实。

qs.stem: Jack is a person with SAD. How could he solve his problem according to the text?
opts: By taking in more fresh air.

ex.ev: The most common treatment for those people is to sit under bright artificial (人工的) lights for some time.
ex.why: 患 SAD 的人最常见的办法是在明亮的人造灯光下坐一会儿——man-made lights 就是人造灯光。

qs.stem: Why is the sentence “Why do we love sunshine?” written in the last paragraph?
opts: To encourage readers to learn more about sunlight.
To advise readers to stay in houses for enough time.
To expect readers to realize the importance of Vitamin
To invite readers to walk into nature to enjoy the fresh air.

ex.ev: In fact, there is more science about sunlight for you to discover.
ex.why: 前一句说关于阳光还有更多科学等你发现，最后一问是鼓励读者继续了解阳光。

cand: adj. 阳光充足的；晴朗的

articles.src: 2025年河南中考
articles.title: Putting things off is something a lot of students are troubled with.
body: Putting things off is something a lot of students are troubled with. Between schoolwork, after-school activities and everyday worries, there are too many things you have to deal with every day. ____36____ You might start falling behind and your grades might get lower.

One smart way to fight back is to break big tasks into tiny pieces. Huge projects can feel like a mountain. But if you cut them into smaller steps, it will make it less scary (可怕的). ____37____ Just tell yourself, “Today, I’ll choose my topic and write a little. I’ll take care of more tomorrow.” step by step, it gets done.

The “work and rest” way is also a smart choice for being productive. Set a timer for 25 minutes-go all in, full attention. ____38____ Have some cookies. Walk around. Once you get going, it’s easier to keep it up.
____39____ Put away your MP3 player and any kind of toys. Find a quiet place where you won’t get interrupted (打扰) at all. The less noise, the better your brain can lock in.

And don’t forget to treat yourself. For example, listen to your favorite song, or watch an interesting TV program. These little things keep you going. ____40____ Finally, you are sure to see the payoff.

opts: Also, stay away from what pulls your attention.
For example, you’ve got to write a five-page paper.
But if you keep putting them off, they can snowball.
Change doesn’t happen overnight, so stick to it every day.

36.ev: You might start falling behind and your grades might get lower.
36.why: 后面说会落下、成绩下降，D「如果一直拖着，它们会像滚雪球一样越积越多」正好引出这个后果。

37.ev: Just tell yourself, “Today, I’ll choose my topic and write a little. I’ll take care of more tomorrow.”
37.why: 后面讲今天先选题、写一点——需要一个具体的任务做例子：C「比如你要写一篇五页的论文」。

38.ev: Set a timer for 25 minutes-go all in, full attention.
38.why: 「学习—休息」法：先专心学 25 分钟，然后 A「休息五分钟」，后面吃饼干、走走都是休息。

39.ev: Put away your MP3 player and any kind of toys.
39.why: 这一段讲收起 MP3、玩具、找安静的地方，B「远离分散注意力的东西」是这一段的中心句。

40.ev: Finally, you are sure to see the payoff.
40.why: 最后说终于会看到回报，前面应是 E「改变不是一夜之间的事，所以每天坚持」。

cand: adj. 富有成效的；高效的

articles.src: 2024年河南中考
articles.title: Vicky's mother opened the door.
body: Vicky's mother opened the door. She had a look at Vicky's bedroom.
"What a mess! It looks as if a hurricane (K) passed through Vicky's bedroom," said
Vicky's mother. "I must ask her to clean it."
Vicky was eating breakfast. Her father came into the kitchen and said, "Mom wants you
to clean your room. It looks as if a hurricane passed through it."
Joe, Vicky's little brother, asked, "A hurricane? Is that a bad thing?"
"Sure it is," said his father.
"I'll do it after school, Dad," said Vicky. "My first class is geography and Mr. Miller
hates people to be late." And off she ran through the front door.
Twenty minutes later, Vicky ran into her classroom.
"Today," said Mr. Miller, "we're going to learn about hurricanes. Have any of you seen a
hurricane?" Vicky thought about her bedroom, but she said nothing.
"I haven't seen one. Not a real one but I watched a program on TV and I know they
destroy (!) things and leave a mess," said James who sat next to Vicky.
"Yes," said Mr. Miller. "But today I'm going to surprise you. Sometimes hurricanes do
good."
"Hurricanes can be good things?" Vicky asked.
"Oh, yes," said Mr. Miller. "Hurricanes bring a lot of water to rivers and lakes that are
becoming dry. Animals and fish come back to live in them. Hurricanes also pick up heat from
the very hot areas of the world and drop it in less warm places."
"So, hurricanes can be good things," Vicky said to herself. "I'm going to show Mom the
good part."
When Vicky got home in the afternoon, she began to clean up her bedroom. She put all
of her things in their proper places.
"Mom," she called. "Can you come here for a minute?"
Vicky's mother put her head around the door.
"Vicky!" she said. "That looks fantastic! I told your dad
this morning that it looked as if a hurricane had hit it!"
"Are you sure that's a bad thing, Mom?" asked Vicky, smiling.

qs.stem: What happened at the beginning of the story?
opts: Vicky made a mess in her room.
Vicky was late for school again.
Vicky had a fight with her brother.

qs.stem: What surprised the students in Mr. Miller's class?

ex.why: 老师说要给大家一个惊喜：飓风有时也有好处（good）。

qs.stem: How would Vicky's mother feel at the end of the story?

ex.ev: "Vicky!" she said. "That looks fantastic! I told your dad
ex.why: 妈妈看到房间收拾好了，说「太棒了」，很高兴。

qs.stem: What can we learn from the story?
opts: Do as what your teachers tell you.
Keep doing what you like till success.
Put what you have learned into practice.
Ask your parents before making a decision.

ex.ev: "So, hurricanes can be good things," Vicky said to herself. "I'm going to show Mom the
ex.why: Vicky 把课上学到的「飓风也有好处」用在了收拾房间上，跟妈妈开了个玩笑——把学到的用起来。

qs.stem: What is the best title for the text?

ex.ev: "Are you sure that's a bad thing, Mom?" asked Vicky, smiling.
ex.why: 整个故事围绕 Vicky 和「飓风」：房间像飓风刮过，学飓风的好处，最后用飓风开玩笑——题目叫「飓风 Vicky」。

articles.src: 2022年河南中考
articles.title: Joey was happy because he had many special friends - four sq
body: Joey was happy because he had many special friends - four squirrels (lil), two
rabbits, and many colorful birds. At the meal time, these wild animals came near to the family
and they would feed these special friends.
In the large yard stood thirteen trees of different sizes. One day, while Joey was playing
with his sister under the trees, he noticed that a tree trunk (W T) had a
sad look. He ran into the house to tell his mom about it. She told Joey
to find the reason why it was sad.
So Joey went into the yard, ran to the sad tree and asked, "Why
are you unhappy?"
"I am the smallest tree around. The birds don't fly to me. The
rabbits don't eat grass under me. The squirrels don't climb to my top.
Nobody needs me or loves me," replied the sad tree.
After knowing the reason, the family had a meeting. Joey suggested making a seat under
the sad tree. Joey's father said he could help make a seat around the tree. The family would sit
under the tree and the tree wouldn't feel sad anymore.
When Joey told his special friends the tree was sad, they decided to do what they could
to help make the sad tree happy again.
Early the next morning, when Joey woke up, he noticed birds singing happily in the little
tree and saw squirrels running up and down in it. Rabbits were eating the fresh grass around
the tree. The little tree was happy again.
Joey ran inside to tell the good news to his family. Joey's mother and father went into the
yard and saw the happy tree.
"Let's start to build the seats around the trees. I will need help to build them. Get the
nails (FIT) for me, Joey," said the father.
"I can help you hold the nails, Dad," said Joey's sister.

qs.stem: Why did the tree feel sad?
opts: Because Joey didn't talk to it.
Because it thought no one liked it.
Because it was the only tree in the yard.
Because Joey's sister didn't play with it.

ex.ev: Nobody needs me or loves me," replied the sad tree.
ex.why: 小树说自己最小，鸟、兔子、松鼠都不来，没人需要它、爱它——它觉得没人喜欢它。

qs.stem: What is the correct order according to the text? a. Joey went to find out why the tree was sad. b. Joey's special friends decided to help the tree. c. Joey found a tree unhappy when he was playing. d. Joey's father started to build the seats around the trees. e. Joey's family discussed how to make the sad tree happy.

ex.ev: with his sister under the trees, he noticed that a tree trunk (W T) had a
ex.why: 顺序：玩的时候发现小树不开心（c）→ 去问原因（a）→ 全家开会想办法（e）→ 动物朋友决定帮忙（b）→ 爸爸开始做座位（d）。

qs.stem: Which words can best describe Joey's family?

ex.ev: After knowing the reason, the family had a meeting. Joey suggested making a seat under
ex.why: 一家人为了让小树高兴，开会想办法、一起动手做座位，又善良又乐于助人。

qs.stem: What can we learn from the text?
opts: The difficulty brought the family together.
Love helped the tree become happy again.
The special friends were thankful to the tree.
The tree spread happiness to everyone around it.

ex.ev: the tree. The little tree was happy again.
ex.why: 家人和动物朋友的关心，让小树重新快乐起来——是爱让小树快乐。

qs.stem: What is the text?

ex.why: 有人物（Joey 一家、小树、动物）和情节，是一个故事。

articles.title: What’s your favourite subject?
body: What’s your favourite subject? What subject is easy for you to learn? Students in middle schools have to learn almost 8 subjects every week. To know more about students’ favourite subjects, we do a survey in No. 2 Middle School. The results (结果) are shown in Diagram (图表) Ⅰ.

From Diagram Ⅰ, we can know that maths is the least popular (最不受欢迎的) subject in school. Why is that? We do a second survey (调查) of the students who don’t like maths and the results are shown in Diagram Ⅱ.
Diagram Ⅰ What’s your favourite subject?
Diagram Ⅱ Why don’t you like maths?

Although maths is difficult, we still believe that it is a useful and important subject because everyone has to use maths each day. To make students be more interested in maths, Mr Wang, the head teacher, in No. 2 Middle School even organizes (组织) some activities, such as calculation (计算) games.

“Do you like maths? Is maths your favourite subject? Do you like to play with numbers? If so, please let more students enjoy learning maths! Because maths is really an important subject,” said Mr Wang.

qs.stem: How does the writer start the passage?

ex.ev: What’s your favourite subject? What subject is easy for you to learn?
ex.why: 文章一开头连问两个问题来引出话题。

qs.stem: The passage is about students’ favourite ________.

ex.ev: To know more about students’ favourite subjects, we do a survey in No. 2 Middle School.
ex.why: 这次调查和全文讲的都是学生最喜欢的学科。

qs.stem: From the last paragraph, we can infer (推断) that ________.
opts: students in No. 2 Middle School don’t like maths at all
students in No. 2 Middle School enjoy learning maths
the head teacher himself really likes to play with numbers
Mr Wang hopes more students can enjoy learning maths

ex.ev: please let more students enjoy learning maths!
ex.why: 王老师说「让更多学生喜欢学数学吧」，可见他希望更多学生喜欢数学。

articles.title: There are many clubs in our school.
body: There are many clubs in our school. Some students join different clubs.
On Monday and Wednesday afternoons, Sam and other students are in Classroom 301 and tell stories in turn (轮流). This is good for Sam’s writing and speaking. Sam also makes friends there.

Susan likes English. Every day after school, Susan comes to Classroom 201 to join in the club activities. The English-speaking students there can help her with English. They talk with each other in English. Susan gets some useful ways to learn English.

Andy loves sports. In the gym, between 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. from Wednesday to Friday, the club’s PE teacher always teaches some skills (技巧). Then there is a basketball game. Many boys like this club.
On Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, Laura has some classes in the art club. She can learn a lot there. Laura can also talk about drawing with the art teacher and her friends.

qs.stem: Where is the English club?

ex.ev: Every day after school, Susan comes to Classroom 201 to join in the club activities.
ex.why: Susan 喜欢英语，每天放学去 201 教室参加英语社团活动；301 是讲故事的社团。

qs.stem: Andy can have basketball classes on ________.

ex.ev: between 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. from Wednesday to Friday
ex.why: 篮球社团是周三到周五，四个选项里只有周四在这几天里。

qs.stem: Which is right about Sam, Susan, Andy and Laura with their clubs? a. the basketball club               b. the art club c. the English club                   d. the story-telling club

ex.ev: On Monday and Wednesday afternoons, Sam and other students are in Classroom 301 and tell stories in turn (轮流).
ex.why: Sam 轮流讲故事（d），Susan 学英语（c），Andy 打篮球（a），Laura 去美术社团（b）。

opts: Many girls like to watch basketball games.
The story-telling club is welcome on Tuesday.
Students in the English club can help us with our English.

articles.title: Middle school students like joining clubs.
body: Middle school students like joining clubs. Joining clubs in middle school can help you make new friends. It can help you know a lot of things. Students need to know something about the clubs.
School clubs take time
Joining a school club isn’t just about having fun, and kids must know that being in a club needs time and needs to do a lot of things.This will make you busier (更忙).

Many students like to meet new friends in the clubs. Lindsay Moore from No. 8 Middle School says, “In the music club, I meet Jane. She likes music and she can play the piano very well. I like music too, and I can play the guitar. So Jane can help me play the piano. I can help her play the guitar. It’s so great.”
What club to join

There are many clubs in schools. Join a club that you like. If you like drawing, you can join the art club. If you like basketball, you can join the sports club. So what club do you want to join? It depends on your interests (兴趣) and hobbies. If your school doesn’t have clubs, you can start a club.
They’re fun
Joining a club can be a lot of fun, so students like the clubs.

qs.stem: Joining a club can make you ________.

ex.ev: This will make you busier (更忙).
ex.why: 原文直接说参加社团要花时间、要做很多事，会让你更忙。

qs.stem: Which can be put into the blank (空白处)?

ex.ev: Many students like to meet new friends in the clubs.
ex.why: 空白处是这一段的小标题，下面讲的是在社团交新朋友、互相帮助——这是「为什么要参加社团」。

qs.stem: What can Jane do?

ex.ev: She likes music and she can play the piano very well.
ex.why: Jane 会弹钢琴；会弹吉他的是 Lindsay 自己。

qs.stem: What does the underlined phrase “depends on” mean in Chinese?

ex.ev: It depends on your interests (兴趣) and hobbies.
ex.why: 参加什么社团，要看你的兴趣爱好——depends on 就是「取决于」。

qs.stem: Which is the best title for the passage?

ex.ev: Middle school students like joining clubs.
ex.why: 全文讲中学生参加社团：要花时间、为什么参加、参加哪个、很有趣，C「参加中学社团」概括得最全。

articles.title: I am your friend, Jack.
body: I am your friend, Jack. I’m busy but very happy at weekends.
On Saturday mornings, I usually do my homework at home. On Saturday afternoons, I have dance classes. I like dancing very much.
Sunday is great for me. On Sunday mornings, I often fly kites with my friends in the park. The park is near the bus station. The park has become a new landmark (地标). It is very beautiful.

There are many different kinds of flowers. I like to take photos there. I also play games, sing or dance with my friends in the park. On Sunday afternoons, I sometimes draw pictures of the setting sun (落日) in the park.
I enjoy spending time in the park. It makes me relax.

ex.ev: I’m busy but very happy at weekends.
ex.why: 第一段原句：周末很忙，但很开心。

ex.why: 周六上午在家写作业；周六下午是舞蹈课。

ex.ev: On Sunday mornings, I often fly kites with my friends in the park.

articles.src: 2024年周口市项城市九年级下学期第一次质量监测4月
articles.title: Whether you are young or old at heart, it is never too late
body: Whether you are young or old at heart, it is never too late to change or take in some new and better practice into your daily life. Here are some wise lessons that I wish I could have known when I was young.

16     Finally I came to realize that if you waste too much time looking for respect from others, you will not have time to finish all your wishes. Everyone has an opinion, but in fact others’ opinions on you are based more on their experiences and perceptions (认知) than anything you’re actually doing.     17

Enjoy every moment of today.     18     Don’t tell yourself you’ll do it tomorrow. If it is important for you, then do it today. Pay attention to what is happening now, the task at hand and all the choices you make today, no matter big and small. Our future is set by what we decide and do today.
19     You can not change it. So let it go. Don’t waste your energy considering anger or unhappiness. It only stops you from moving forward in life.
Look for the good in people. Celebrate the happy moments, big and small. Search for the changes for growth.     20     Be helpful whenever possible.
In a word, life is serious but you can still be happy and hopeful. Otherwise, what’s the point?

opts: So depend on your own assessment (评估) rather than others’.
Don’t wait to do or enjoy something.
I used to be worried about what others thought of me.
Give helpful encouragement rather than unwanted criticism (批评).

16.ev: Finally I came to realize that if you waste too much time looking for respect from others, you will not have time to finish all your wishes.
16.why: 后面说「最后我才明白，花太多时间在乎别人的看法……」，前面应是 D「我以前总担心别人怎么看我」。

17.ev: but in fact others’ opinions on you are based more on their experiences and perceptions (认知) than anything you’re actually doing.
17.why: 别人的看法更多取决于他们自己，所以 B「要相信自己的判断，而不是别人的」。

18.ev: Don’t tell yourself you’ll do it tomorrow. If it is important for you, then do it today.
18.why: 这一段讲珍惜今天、别拖到明天，C「想做什么、想享受什么，别等」。

19.ev: You can not change it. So let it go.
19.why: 后面说「你改变不了它，那就放下」，it 指 A「昨天发生的事已经过去了」。

20.ev: Look for the good in people. Celebrate the happy moments, big and small.
20.why: 这一段讲看别人的优点、多帮助人，E「多给人有用的鼓励，少给不需要的批评」。

articles.src: 2024年周口市商水县九年级一模
articles.title: “Peter! Pick up your toys!
body: “Peter! Pick up your toys!” said his mum for the fifth time. But Peter was so excited about his new video game that he didn’t hear his mother. After dinner, his mum asked Peter to help her clear the table, but Peter ran to his room to continue playing the video game, instead of picking up the dirty dishes.
The next day, Peter woke up and went downstairs to the kitchen. He was surprised to find that One-eyed Captain (船长)—the pirate (海盗) from his video game—sat at the table.
“Bu...but...where is my mum? What are you doing here?”

“Your mum does not live here anymore. She got tired of you ignoring her every time she asked you to do something. Now, I will live in your house with my crew (全体船员), and you will do everything we ask you to do.”
“But nothing, I was waiting for you to wake up to prepare my breakfast. Hurry up, my crew are about to come.”

Peter started working, preparing breakfast for the whole crew, and then had to clear the table, wash the dishes and tidy up the kitchen. After the Captain and his crew took a bath, Peter had to pick up all the clothes and clean all the mess in the bathroom.

Peter spent the whole day following the pirates, picking up everything around. When night fell, Peter was very tired, and he asked the pirates to help him with the cleaning. The Captain looked at him and all of them started laughing. That made Peter angry. Then he woke up.
He then understood that it had been just a dream and thought: My mum might be as tired as I was in my dream every night. From now on, I should make a change.

qs.stem: What did Peter do when his mother asked him to help her?
opts: He picked up the dirty dishes.

ex.ev: but Peter ran to his room to continue playing the video game, instead of picking up the dirty dishes.
ex.why: 妈妈让他帮忙收拾桌子，他却跑回房间继续玩游戏。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “ignoring” mean in Chinese?

ex.ev: She got tired of you ignoring her every time she asked you to do something.
ex.why: 妈妈每次叫他做事，他都不理（第一句就叫了五遍都没听见）——ignore 是「忽视、不理睬」。

qs.stem: How did Peter’s feelings change after he saw the Captain in his dream? [图:reading/989b57f8/image2.png]

ex.why: 看见船长：先是吃惊，接着结结巴巴说「可……可……可是」，说明他很紧张，后面才是累和生气。

qs.stem: What did Peter mean by thinking “I should make a change”?
opts: He would never play the game.
He would learn from the Captain.
He would help his mother do housework.
He would talk with his mother more often.

ex.ev: My mum might be as tired as I was in my dream every night.
ex.why: 他明白妈妈每天都像梦里的自己一样累，要改变，就是以后帮妈妈做家务。

qs.stem: What does the writer want to tell us?
opts: Kids should value what mothers do.
Kids can learn something in dreams.
Kids may be tired after doing housework.
Kids shouldn’t play video games too much.

ex.ev: My mum might be as tired as I was in my dream every night. From now on, I should make a change.
ex.why: Peter 通过梦体会到妈妈做家务的辛苦——孩子应该珍惜妈妈的付出。

articles.src: 2024年周口市西华县中考一模
articles.title: Encouraged by the 13th-century book “The Travels of Marco Po
body: Encouraged by the 13th-century book “The Travels of Marco Polo”, Italian physicist (物理学家) Alessandro Codello started his own Silk Road journey a few years ago from Italy. He traveled through countries including Greece, Turkey, Iran, Afghanistan, and finally China. During his trip, Codello carried “The Travels of Marco Polo” with him. “Every time I reached a new area, I tried to find ideas or places that matched Polo’s words...The most interesting thing was finding what he wrote in the book was right in front of my eyes.” he shared.

Codello is very interested in the markets along the way, as lively trades and exchanges took place in those places. From time to time, he was invited to give speeches and attend meetings at universities. He mentioned that as a physicist, he couldn’t wait to find anything related to science along the way. He talked about his trip to Khiva in Uzbekistan. It is the hometown of mathematician Al-Khwarizmi（780﹣850）, from whom the word “algorithm (算法) ‘gets its name’. It’s closely related with Shenzhen today,” he said. “It is very important to many problems and technologies that engineers in Shenzhen meet.”

When Codello finally arrived in China at the end of his journey, he felt the same curiosity as Marco Polo. “When I first arrived in China, I was not used to paying with a phone. I was amazed that banknotes were not commonly used. However, when Marco Polo was here, he was amazed that people in China were using paper money. Once again, I shared the same feeling with Marco Polo,” Codello said.

qs.stem: Where did Codello begin his journey?

ex.ev: started his own Silk Road journey a few years ago from Italy.
ex.why: 他从意大利出发开始丝绸之路之旅。

qs.stem: How does Codello like “The Travels of Marco Polo”?

ex.ev: Encouraged by the 13th-century book “The Travels of Marco Polo”,
ex.why: 第一句说他是受《马可·波罗游记》鼓舞才出发的，这本书对他是一种鼓励。

qs.stem: Why did Codello visit Khiva in Uzbekistan?
opts: He had a meeting with Al-Khwarizmi.
He wanted to visit the market of that city.
He was interested in a local mathematician.
He hoped to improve Shenzhen’s technology.

ex.ev: It is the hometown of mathematician Al-Khwarizmi（780﹣850）, from whom the word “algorithm (算法) ‘gets its name’.
ex.why: 他是物理学家，对科学感兴趣；希瓦是数学家花剌子模的家乡，「算法」一词就来自他的名字。

qs.stem: What is the main idea of paragraph 3?
opts: Chinese no longer use paper money.
Codello spends many days in China.
Codello enjoys the new way of paying.
Great changes in China surprise Codello.

ex.ev: I was amazed that banknotes were not commonly used.
ex.why: 第三段讲他到中国后发现大家用手机付钱、不太用纸币，很惊讶——中国的巨大变化让他吃惊。

qs.stem: What is the best title of the text?

ex.why: 全文讲他带着《马可·波罗游记》重走丝绸之路，一路对照书里写的——「重新发现丝绸之路」。

articles.src: 2024年周口市西华县中考一模
articles.title: Besides the main subjects, international students at Shangha
body: Besides the main subjects, international students at Shanghai Maritime University are also offered a window into Chinese culture. According to the university, many students chose culture-related classes last year.     16

Dragon boat classes have always interested many international students. The university has its own race team to train students.     17     Benjamin Baffoe, a member of the team, says that it is great to come to China and have the chance to learn about dragon boating.     18     Having learned the sport for six years in China, Baffoe is now stronger and more confident. “That’s what life is about: Never give up and always try,” he says.

Tai Chi is also one of the most popular sports among international students at SMU. For them, understanding the culture behind the sport is more difficult than practice. David Bobadilla of Chile, however, already has a good understanding of Chinese culture through his study of kung fu. “    19     Tai Chi is more for internal development and kung fu is more of an external sport, but their concept is the same,” he says.

20     During the New Year’s party for foreign students at SMU, Shreya Pandey from Nepal recited Man Jiang Hong, a Chinese poem written by Yue Fei. “The preparation for the performance helped me to learn about Yue Fei’s story as well as the history, language, and culture of China. I love to learn different kinds of poems,” says Pandey.

opts: The team has won many races since 2012.
He only saw the dragon boat race on TV when he was a child.
Chinese poetry classes make big differences to foreign students.
They are provided with many chances to learn Chinese culture.
There are some differences in the practice between Tai Chi and kung fu.

16.ev: According to the university, many students chose culture-related classes last year.
16.why: 第一段说留学生有机会了解中国文化，很多人选了文化课，D「他们有很多机会学习中国文化」接着说。

17.ev: The university has its own race team to train students.
17.why: 前一句说学校有自己的龙舟队，A「这个队从 2012 年起赢了很多比赛」接着介绍这个队。

18.ev: it is great to come to China and have the chance to learn about dragon boating.
18.why: 他说能来中国学龙舟太好了，B「他小时候只在电视上看过龙舟赛」说明他为什么这么高兴。

19.ev: Tai Chi is more for internal development and kung fu is more of an external sport, but their concept is the same,
19.why: 后面比较太极和功夫：一个练内、一个练外，理念相同——前面先说 E「太极和功夫在练法上有一些不同」。

20.ev: During the New Year’s party for foreign students at SMU, Shreya Pandey from Nepal recited Man Jiang Hong, a Chinese poem written by Yue Fei.
20.why: 这一段讲留学生背诵《满江红》、学中国诗，开头用 C「中国诗歌课给留学生带来很大变化」。

cand: adj. 外国的；来自国外的

articles.src: 2024年漯河市舞阳县中考一模
articles.title: Ryan’s life was nearly perfect.
body: Ryan’s life was nearly perfect. He had lots of friends on his block. They walked to school together every day, and after school they always had time to play.
Ryan did have one problem. It was his two-year-old sister, Allie. She was too small to play ball games. She couldn’t climb trees yet. Ryan and his friends didn’t want her around.
Ryan tried asking his mom to keep Allie at home. “Why does my sister have to come along?” he asked, “Troy’s sister doesn’t. Jimmy’s sister doesn’t. Why mine?”
Ryan’s mother just laughed, “Troy’s sister is only six months old, and Jimmy doesn’t have a sister. Allie is nice, isn’t she?”

Today, Ryan was going to play baseball with his friends after school. Allie followed him as usual. The boys used to play football, but one of them broke a window at Mr. Mewhirter’s house. Mr. Mewhirter wouldn’t give them their ball back.
The game got started. Allie sat on a stone nearby. Minutes later it was Jimmy’s turn to hit the ball. Unluckily, it fell right into Mr. Mewhirter’s yard.
The boys ran over to Mr. Mewhirter’s fence. The ball was just out of reach.
“None of us can fit through the fence.” Jimmy said.
The boys looked glum.
Suddenly, Jimmy got an idea. “Allie, come over!” he called. “Would you like to get that ball for us?”
Allie looked at the boys. Then she slipped through the fence, picked up the ball and came back out of the yard. A piece of cake for the small girl!
“Wow,” said Troy. “So quick! Thanks, Allie.”
“Nice job,” said Jimmy.
“Come on,” said Ryan, suddenly proud of his kid sister. “I’ll teach you how to swing (舞动) the bat.”

qs.stem: What can we know about Ryan’s sister?
opts: She was two years younger than Ryan.
She was friends with Troy’s sister.

ex.ev: Allie followed him as usual.
ex.why: 妹妹「像往常一样」跟着他，可见她经常跟着 Ryan。她才两岁，不会爬树。

qs.stem: Why didn’t Ryan and his friends play football today?
opts: Mr Mewhirter refused to return their football.
They got bored with playing it.
They lent their football to other boys.

ex.ev: Mr. Mewhirter wouldn’t give them their ball back.
ex.why: 他们踢球打碎了 Mewhirter 先生家的窗户，他不肯把球还给他们。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “glum” mean?

ex.ev: “None of us can fit through the fence.” Jimmy said.
ex.why: 球掉进邻居院子，谁都钻不过篱笆，大家都很发愁——glum 是「闷闷不乐、发愁」。

qs.stem: Which sentence shows that Ryan changed the way he thought about his sister?
opts: “Why does my sister have to come along?”
“I’ll teach you how to swing the bat.”
“Would you like to get that ball for us?”

ex.ev: “Come on,” said Ryan, suddenly proud of his kid sister. “I’ll teach you how to swing (舞动) the bat.”
ex.why: Ryan 原来嫌妹妹碍事，最后突然为她骄傲，还主动要教她挥球棒——看法变了。

qs.stem: Which fact about Allie is the most important to the story?

ex.ev: Then she slipped through the fence, picked up the ball and came back out of the yard.
ex.why: 正因为 Allie 个子小，才能钻过篱笆把球捡回来——这是故事最关键的地方。

articles.src: 2024年济源市中考一模
articles.title: The weekend is coming.
body: The weekend is coming. Will you join in some activities with your parents or friends? Here’s some advice for you.

Library Activities for Children City Public Library offers a lot of fun and educational activities for children all year round. The activities are all free. Please sign up on the Internet to get more information and never miss an event.

Read to a Pet 1:00-2:30 p.m./2nd and last Saturday of the month/3rd Floor Children’s Area This program is a relaxing way for young readers to improve their reading skills. Dogs and cats trained by Paws for Love are nice and friendly. This is a drop-in program, and sign-ups are not necessary.

Discovery Room The Discovery Room gives chances for children to think creatively, use theirimagination, and learn while playing. The theme of the Discovery Room changes four times a year. Discovery Room hours often change, too. Please call before you come to find out when it will be open.

Monthly Lego (乐高) Party 2:00-3:00 p.m./3rd Saturday of the month/Story Rooms Floor 3 Kids with their grown-ups are invited for an hour of Lego play. Legos are provided. Bring your imagination! This creative activity is for ages 4 and up.

After-School Art Activity 4:30-5:30 p.m./3rd Thursday of the month/Story Rooms A&B School-age kids from 2nd to 5th grade are invited to an after-school activity in arts. Sign up online or at the Children’s Ask Here Desk.

qs.stem: Who is the text written for?

ex.ev: Will you join in some activities with your parents or friends? Here’s some advice for you.
ex.why: 开头问「你会和父母或朋友一起参加活动吗」，是对孩子说的。

qs.stem: If you are a book lover and like pets, you may join in

ex.ev: This program is a relaxing way for young readers to improve their reading skills. Dogs and cats trained by Paws for Love are nice and friendly.
ex.why: 「给宠物读书」：喜欢读书的孩子读给猫狗听，正适合爱书又爱宠物的人。

qs.stem: What can we learn from the Discovery Room?
opts: Whenever you go, it will be open for you.
It is helpful for children’s thinking ability.
It’s designed for children over the age of four.

ex.ev: The Discovery Room gives chances for children to think creatively, use theirimagination, and learn while playing.
ex.why: 发现屋让孩子创造性地思考、发挥想象，有助于思维能力。主题一年换四次，开放时间也常变。

qs.stem: Which boy most probably took part in the art activity?
opts: Jack had fun there with his parents on April 1st.
Mike enjoyed a lot of classical music after school.
Bob made a lot of calls to join this activity last night.
Bruce went to the Story Rooms Floor 3 with his classmates.

ex.ev: School-age kids from 2nd to 5th grade are invited to an after-school activity in arts.
ex.why: 美术活动是给二到五年级在校学生的放学后活动，在 Story Rooms。和父母一起是乐高派对；报名在网上或服务台，不是打电话。

qs.stem: Where is the text most probably from?

ex.ev: Please sign up on the Internet to get more information and never miss an event.
ex.why: 介绍图书馆活动，还让大家上网报名、了解更多——最可能是网页。

articles.src: 2024年济源市中考一模
articles.title: I grew up in a poor family.
body: I grew up in a poor family. My dad died when I was three, leaving my mom with the job of raising nine kids. She had two jobs every day and she was a very hard worker. In order to make ends meet, she hardly ever rested.

My mom did all she could to support our family. Though we kids didn’t get what we wanted, we always got the things we needed. With my mom as my role model, I learned that hard work is the best way to get what you want.
While growing up, I never considered myself as a person in a difficult situation. I saw my life more as a card that had been dealt to me and I tried to make the most of it.
Of course, I dreamed about what I would be. At first, I wanted to be a soldier. Then I decided to be a driver. I even thought about being a footballer.
Surprising as it might seem, basketball wasn’t in my plans. I only started playing basketball on a team when I was in middle school. I loved to compete and worked hard to win.
For me, it paid off. I just let my success in basketball take its course, but I always put the effort in every day.

No matter what I did, some people expected me to fail, saying, “Karl can’t do it.” Instead of letting people like that get to me, I continued to prove (证明) them wrong. I tried my best to make my family proud.
While everyone else was looking up to popular sports stars, actors and musicians, my mom was my hero. She taught me that hard work pays off.

At the end of my life, I don’t want to be remembered as the kind of person who just sat on his bottom and said, “I’ve made it.” I don’t want to say that I get what I have now without putting in much effort. Sure there are days that I don’t feel like working hard…but I do it anyway. And that’s how I’m working toward becoming a successful basketball player.

qs.stem: What did the writer learn from his mother?
opts: How to be a role model.

ex.ev: With my mom as my role model, I learned that hard work is the best way to get what you want.
ex.why: 以妈妈为榜样，他明白了努力是得到想要东西的最好办法——努力的价值。

qs.stem: What does the underlined sentence “basketball wasn’t in my plans” mean?
opts: He never asked his mom for a basketball.
He hardly spared the time to play basketball.
He seldom made plans for his basketball training.
He didn’t expect to be a basketball player at first.

ex.ev: I only started playing basketball on a team when I was in middle school.
ex.why: 他小时候想当兵、当司机、当足球运动员，上中学才开始打篮球——一开始没想过当篮球运动员。

qs.stem: How did the writer deal with the people who looked down on him?
opts: He kept himself away from them.
He tried his best to compete with them.
He worked harder to prove them wrong.

ex.ev: Instead of letting people like that get to me, I continued to prove (证明) them wrong.
ex.why: 有人说他不行，他不受影响，继续用行动证明他们错了。

qs.stem: Which of the following words best describe the writer?

ex.ev: Sure there are days that I don’t feel like working hard…but I do it anyway.
ex.why: 不想努力的日子也照样努力，被人看不起也不放弃——勤奋、意志坚强。

qs.stem: What’s the writer’s writing purpose?
opts: To advise people to dream big.
To share his story of growing up.
To thank his mom for supporting him.
To explain why he wanted to be a player.

ex.ev: I grew up in a poor family.
ex.why: 全文从穷苦的童年讲到妈妈的榜样、自己的梦想和打篮球——分享他的成长故事。

articles.src: 2024年济源市中考一模
articles.title: Do you know there are sounds produced by plants?
body: Do you know there are sounds produced by plants? Have you ever wondered what animals are talking about? With the development of AI, we may be able to understand their languages!

In Professor Karen Bakker’s new book, The Sounds of Life: How Digital Technology Is Bringing Us Closer to the Worlds of Animals and Plants, she talks about how AI and other technologies are helping us to translate and understand animals’ and plants’ words.

All around the animal world, there are sounds that we can hardly pick up and decipher (破译). Elephants, for example, talk with each other using infra-sound (次声), which cannot be heard by human ears. Coral (珊瑚) in the ocean also sends sound waves to lead baby coral to safer areas to grow. Baby coral “listens” for the sounds and finds its way to the right place. This is surprising as coral doesn’t have any ears! Scientists have placed machines into these environments to pick up the sounds humans cannot hear.

After the sounds are recorded, AI can study their meaning. For example, Isracli researchers used AI to translate bats’ (蝙蝠) 15,000 calls. They found that more than 60 percent were arguments about such things: food, ways of sleeping, getting into personal space, and unwanted courtship (求偶).

Technologies can not only understand the animals but communicate back to them. For example, bees use dances to communicate. So a research team in Germany put the bee language AI system into a robot bee. They asked the robot to create a set of dance moves to tell the bees where they can find their food.
Researchers said the technology could someday help disabled people to communicate. It might also help scientists understand how animals see the world.

qs.stem: How does the writer lead into the topic?

ex.ev: Do you know there are sounds produced by plants? Have you ever wondered what animals are talking about?
ex.why: 开头连问两个问题引出话题。

qs.stem: What can we learn from Karen Bakker’s new book?
opts: What role AI plays in protecting animals.
What makes it hard for us to take care of plants.
How animals and plants communicate with the help of AI.
How technologies help us understand the voices of nature.

ex.ev: she talks about how AI and other technologies are helping us to translate and understand animals’ and plants’ words.
ex.why: 书里讲的是人工智能等技术怎样帮我们翻译、听懂动植物的「话」——大自然的声音。

qs.stem: What do elephants and coral have in common?
opts: Their languages can be easily understood by the robots.
They make special calls to discuss matters like ways of sleeping.
Humans cannot pick up the sounds they make for communication.
They can pick up infra-sound which is sent by the special machines.

ex.ev: Scientists have placed machines into these environments to pick up the sounds humans cannot hear.
ex.why: 大象用人耳听不到的次声交流，珊瑚没有耳朵也靠声波——它们交流的声音人都听不到。

qs.stem: Why is the example of bats mentioned?
opts: To tell readers that bats are clever animals.
To list the kinds of arguments animals usually have.
To describe the difference between animals and plants.
To show what AI can do with the sounds scientists collected.

ex.ev: After the sounds are recorded, AI can study their meaning.
ex.why: 这一段先说录下声音后 AI 能研究它们的意思，蝙蝠的例子就是说明 AI 能做什么。

qs.stem: What is the researchers’ attitude (态度) towards the future of the AI technology?

ex.ev: Researchers said the technology could someday help disabled people to communicate.
ex.why: 研究人员说这项技术将来能帮助残疾人交流、帮科学家了解动物——态度是支持的。

articles.src: 2024年商丘市夏邑县第二初级中学教育集团中考一模
articles.title: When I was in the sixth grade, my teacher asked our class, “
body: When I was in the sixth grade, my teacher asked our class, “What does ‘doing the right thing’ mean to you?” She asked us to think about it over the weekend, and to talk to anyone else we thought might have a good answer. By Monday, we should hand in an article on it, and get prepared to live up to our answers.

The whole weekend, I tried to come up with something that would impress my teacher and be easy to do. I talked to my parents, called my grandmother, and asked my next door neighbor. Everyone had good answers, but I didn’t feel like I could do them.

On Sunday afternoon my parents took me to my Aunt Cindy’s house. After dinner, my parents told me to play with my four-year-old cousin Andrea while they were away. I turned on the television and found a cartoon movie for Andrea, and then I sat down and started to write my article. I still don’t know what I was going to write about. Soon I felt a pair of eyes on me. It was Andrea.
“What are you doing, Daisy?” she asked.
“I have to write an article about what doing the right thing means to me, ” I answered. Andrea laughed. “That’s easy,” she said.
“Okay, tell me the answer,” I said.
“Doing the right thing means being nice to your family and friends. Doing what your mom says. Never lie. Take a bath when you’re dirty. Don’t waste water and electricity.”

I looked at Andrea amazingly. Not only had she answered a very difficult question for me, but I could easily follow all of her rules. And all I had to do was to be nice. So when I wrote my article, I included the story about Andrea.
Two weeks later, my teacher returned everyone’s articles. I received an A+ along with a little note my teacher had written: “Always do the right thing and give Andrea an A+, too!”

qs.stem: What does the underlined part “live up to our answers” mean in Paragraph 1?
opts: Finish writing our articles over the weekend.
Come up with good ideas before writing.
Do the things that we mention in our articles.
Talk to anyone who might help give an answer.

ex.ev: By Monday, we should hand in an article on it, and get prepared to live up to our answers.
ex.why: 不光要交文章，还要准备「做到」自己写的答案——live up to 就是按自己说的去做。

qs.stem: What is the CORRECT order of the writer’s activities? ①She talked to several people about the question. ②She tried to think of something special and easy to do. ③She introduced how Andrea helped her in her article. ④She asked Andrea to tell her the answer to the question.

ex.ev: The whole weekend, I tried to come up with something that would impress my teacher and be easy to do.
ex.why: 顺序：先想既特别又好做的事（②），再去问父母、奶奶、邻居（①），后来问表妹 Andrea（④），最后把她的故事写进文章（③）。

qs.stem: Why did the teacher ask the students to write the article?
opts: To tell them how to admire other people.
To help them think about things carefully.
To advise them to ask for help from others.
To educate them always to do the right thing.

ex.ev: “Always do the right thing and give Andrea an A+, too!”
ex.why: 老师的评语点明了目的：让学生永远做正确的事。

articles.src: 2024年商丘市夏邑县第二初级中学教育集团中考一模
articles.title: Once, there was a young man who expected to be successful badly.
body: Once, there was a young man who expected to be successful badly. One day, he visited Socrates, the great and successful Greek philosopher (哲学家), and asked the man about the secret to success. He hoped that this man, who he respected (尊敬) a lot, could show him something useful and helpful. After knowing the young man’s purpose, Socrates decided to do something to calm (使平静) him down first. Looking at the worried young man in silence for a while, Socrates told the young man to meet him near the river outside the city the next morning. Dare not ask Socrates why, the puzzled young man left.

The next day, the young man came early and waited. When the great man arrived, he asked the young man to walk with him toward the river together. They walked side by side in the river. Though the young man was still puzzled (困惑的), he followed. When the water got up to their necks, Socrates took the young man by surprise and ducked him into the water all of a sudden. The poor man tried hard, hoping to get out directly, but Socrates was strong and kept him there until the poor man’s face started turning blue.

After pulling his head out of the water, the first thing the young man did was to take a deep breath of the air. Waiting for a while, when seeing the young man calm down, Socrates asked slowly, “Now please tell me. What did you want most when you were in the water?” The man replied, “Air.” Hearing the young man’s answer, Socrates said, “Now, you see, that is the secret to success. Only when you want something as badly as you wanted the air just now in the water, will you get it!”

Sometimes we are always so eager (渴望的) to be successful that we can’t make ourselves understand what we really need. So, learn your situation to get to know what you want most and try your best, and then you may get it.

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “ducked” mean in Chinese according to the text?

ex.ev: Socrates took the young man by surprise and ducked him into the water all of a sudden.
ex.why: 水没到脖子时，苏格拉底突然把他按进水里，他拼命挣扎想出来——ducked 是「把……按进水里」。

qs.stem: What did they do in the water?
opts: Socrates stood in the water with the young man side by side for long.
Socrates put the young man’s head into the water for long.
Socrates walked with the young man in the water for long.
Socrates swam and talked with the young man for long.

ex.ev: but Socrates was strong and kept him there until the poor man’s face started turning blue.
ex.why: 苏格拉底把年轻人的头按在水里，直到他脸都发青了，时间很长。

qs.stem: How did Socrates make the young man get his idea?
opts: By telling the way to success.
By giving the young man some useful suggestions.
By giving a special lesson to the young man.
By giving the young man lots of money and things.

ex.ev: Now, you see, that is the secret to success.
ex.why: 苏格拉底没有直接讲道理，而是让他亲身体会想要空气的感觉——给他上了特别的一课。

qs.stem: Which word can best describe Socrates according to the text?

ex.ev: Only when you want something as badly as you wanted the air just now in the water, will you get it!
ex.why: 用一件事让年轻人自己明白成功的秘诀，说明苏格拉底很有智慧。

qs.stem: According to the story, how can we achieve success?
opts: By trying to make as much money as we could.
By talking with a great man and getting his secret to success.
By letting Socrates put the head into the water.
By finding out what we want and do our best.

ex.ev: So, learn your situation to get to know what you want most and try your best, and then you may get it.
ex.why: 最后一段：弄清自己最想要什么，然后尽全力，就可能得到。

articles.title: Poster Competition for Children!
body: Poster Competition for Children!       Calling all children and teens! During this year we are asking you to create a poster that will encourage people to find ways to let the earth rest!

articles.src: 2024年洛阳市中考一模
articles.title: Bethany Beyer, our Grade 7 teacher, was a really good teacher.
body: [图:reading/8d6bbbaf/image2.png]
Bethany Beyer, our Grade 7 teacher, was a really good teacher. She cared about her students. That’s why she was named “Teacher of the Year”.
She told us a funny story about her first day as a teacher. She said, “On my first day as a teacher, I was nervous and scared. I told myself I would never be able to do this!”

“The morning I was to begin teaching, I arrived really early. My hands were shaking. My throat was dry. My stomach was filled with butterflies. I looked at the clock. The students would arrive in five minutes. I felt a wave of panic (恐慌) inside.”
“I was so frightened. I hid myself behind the desk. The students came in and looked for their teacher. I heard them saying, ‘Where is she? Where is our new teacher, Ms. Beyer?’”

“Finally, I stood up from behind the desk. Everyone was surprised. I decided to be honest with my students. I took a deep breath and told the kids how worried I was. But I also told them that I wanted to be their best friend and best teacher, too.”

“They did not laugh at me. They understood my fear. One boy named Jim said, ‘That’s okay, Ms. Beyer, I get scared too.’ The students were all standing there smiling at me. They made me feel so comfortable and relieved (如释重负的). My fear slowly disappeared.”
“I can make a joke about it now, but on my first day as a teacher, I was ready to run away. I’m very glad that I stayed and beat my fear.”
“I am ‘Teacher of the Year’ now. But on my first day as a teacher, my fear almost got the best of myself.” She added.

qs.stem: Why was Bethany Beyer named “Teacher of the Year”?
opts: Because she cared about her students.

ex.ev: She cared about her students. That’s why she was named “Teacher of the Year”.
ex.why: 原文直接说：她关心学生，所以被评为年度教师。

qs.stem: What does the underlined sentence in Paragraph 3 mean?
opts: I was unhappy and wanted to cry.
There were some butterflies in my stomach.
There were some butterflies flying in the classroom.

ex.ev: My hands were shaking. My throat was dry.
ex.why: 手发抖、嗓子发干，「肚子里像有蝴蝶」是形容非常紧张。

qs.stem: What did Bethany Beyer do before her first class?
opts: She got to the classroom late.
She introduced herself with a smile.

ex.ev: I hid myself behind the desk.
ex.why: 她太害怕了，躲到了讲桌后面。

qs.stem: Which words can best describe the student called Jim in the text?

ex.ev: One boy named Jim said, ‘That’s okay, Ms. Beyer, I get scared too.’
ex.why: Jim 安慰老师「没关系，我也会害怕」——善良、会关心人。

qs.stem: What do we mainly learn from the text?
opts: We should be a good teacher.
We should learn to get over our fear.
We should treat others with kindness.

ex.ev: I’m very glad that I stayed and beat my fear.
ex.why: 她第一天差点被恐惧打败，最后留下来战胜了它——我们要学会克服恐惧。

articles.title: Autumn Equinox (秋分) is an important event in many cultures a
body: Autumn Equinox (秋分) is an important event in many cultures and traditions around the world.     16     So on this day, people have some special activities to celebrate it.Standing eggs up on their ends

On Autumn Equinox day, thousands of people around the world try to make eggs stand on end. This Chinese custom has become the world’s game. China Daily has noted something about the better eggs for the game.     17    Sending the autumn cattle (秋牛)

The so-called autumn cattle is a piece of red or yellow paper printed with solar terms (节气) and a picture of farming cow. On Autumn Equinox, people often take these papers from house to house and say or sing some words with good wishes.     18    Eating qiucai

Qiucai is a kind of wild autumn vegetable.     19     Every Autumn Equinox day, some people in South China go to pick qiucai in the wild. Then, they put qiucai into soup with fish. It’s believed to clear the liver and intestines (肝和肠) and make people healthy.

20     As we enjoy these activities, Autumn Equinox is more than a day. It’s a celebration of nature’s balance and a time for us to join in age-old traditions. Every action we do, big or small, can bring us closer to understanding the world around us.请你

opts: It is on September 22nd this year.
It’s thin and about 20 centimeters long.
They may get some pocket money for doing this.
Eggs about four or five days old are better for the game.
These special activities show the meaningful moments of each season.

16.ev: Autumn Equinox (秋分) is an important event in many cultures and traditions around the world.
16.why: 第一段介绍秋分，A「今年秋分在 9 月 22 日」补充时间。

17.ev: China Daily has noted something about the better eggs for the game.
17.why: 前面说《中国日报》提到用什么样的蛋更好，D「四五天的蛋更适合这个游戏」就是答案。

18.ev: On Autumn Equinox, people often take these papers from house to house and say or sing some words with good wishes.
18.why: 挨家挨户送秋牛图、说吉祥话，C「他们可能因此得到一些零花钱」接着说。

19.ev: Qiucai is a kind of wild autumn vegetable.
19.why: 先说秋菜是一种野菜，B「它细细的，大约 20 厘米长」接着描述样子。

20.ev: As we enjoy these activities, Autumn Equinox is more than a day.
20.why: 最后一段总结，E「这些特别的活动体现了每个季节有意义的时刻」。

articles.src: 2024年南阳市南召县中考三模
articles.title: There was a businessman named Jim.
body: There was a businessman named Jim. He woke up at 5 in the morning. After that, he was used to going to work.
He worked very hard and his work went well, which made him become richer. When Jim asked his son Sam to go to work with him in the morning, Sam did not get up because of laziness.

Later Jim fell ill and passed away. But Sam slept till late as before. Because of this, there was a loss (亏损) in business. Seeing this, Sam’s mother said to him, “There is a loss in our business. Do something to make it right.”
Sam said to his mother, “I don’t know business.” His mother said, “Your grandfather lives in another village. You can go to him and learn some business skills.”

Sam visited his grandfather. He told his grandfather about the loss in business. Then his grandfather advised Sam to wake up at 5 in the morning, and go to work. According to the advice of his grandfather, Sam got up at 5 in the morning and started going to work. During that time, he learned some useful lessons that he didn’t know before, so he decided to change himself.

Later his business started running well again, just like before. Sam’s mother was very happy and she asked Sam to take some gifts to thank his grandfather, who made all this happen. Sam did as his mother told him.
Sam’s grandfather said to him, “You used to be lazy. Now you have overcome laziness, so the business runs well again.” Sam understood that he should never be lazy.

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “which” refer to in the passage?
opts: He was used to going to his fields.
He worked hard and his work went well.

ex.ev: He worked very hard and his work went well, which made him become richer.
ex.why: which 指前面整件事：他工作努力，而且工作很顺利，这让他更富有了。

qs.stem: What was Sam like before his father passed away?

ex.ev: Sam did not get up because of laziness.
ex.why: 爸爸叫他早上一起去工作，他因为懒不起床。

qs.stem: How did Sam make the business run well again?
opts: By asking his mother for help.

ex.ev: Now you have overcome laziness, so the business runs well again.
ex.why: 爷爷说：你克服了懒惰，所以生意又好起来了。

qs.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Sam didn’t get up because of illness.
Sam told his mother about the loss.
Sam took some gifts to thank his grandfather.
Sam never got up at 5 in the morning.

ex.ev: Sam’s mother was very happy and she asked Sam to take some gifts to thank his grandfather, who made all this happen. Sam did as his mother told him.
ex.why: 妈妈让他带礼物去感谢爷爷，他照做了。是妈妈告诉他亏损的；后来他每天 5 点起床。

qs.stem: What lesson can we learn from the passage?
opts: The early bird catches the worm.
It’s never too old to learn.

ex.ev: Then his grandfather advised Sam to wake up at 5 in the morning, and go to work.
ex.why: 早起勤快生意就好，偷懒晚起就亏损——早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

cand: adj. 生病的；身体不适的

articles.src: 2024年南阳市南召县中考三模
articles.title: Most people love animals.
body: Most people love animals. Many children’s books use animals as the main characters.     16     The love for animals may be why both children and adults enjoy going to zoos.

In the past, zoos were usually started by rich people. The first zoo was started by a queen in Egypt in 1500 BC. Raising animals was a way for people to show they were wealthy and powerful. Sadly, the animals in the early zoos were not treated well.     17

Today, zoos still bring people pleasure, but they try to protect animals and teach people as well.     18     People must provide animals with a clean place to live, food, water, and health care. In this way, the rules help protect the animals.

19     They want to do more to protect the animals they love. For example, people disapproved of the use of some large animals in shows. They thought the zoos didn’t have enough space for the animals to show.     20    With so many people against the shows, the zoos decided to make a change.
People see animals in zoos. At the same time, they try to learn and protect them. Both people and animals can get a lot from each other.

opts: Many people look after animals as pets.
They didn’t receive enough attention or care.
Some people think the rules are not enough.
They also thought the animals were not treated properly.

16.ev: Many children’s books use animals as the main characters.
16.why: 这里讲人们爱动物：童书里常用动物当主角，B「很多人把动物当宠物养」接着举例。

17.ev: Sadly, the animals in the early zoos were not treated well.
17.why: 早期动物园里的动物没被好好对待，C「它们没有得到足够的关注和照顾」接着说。

18.ev: People must provide animals with a clean place to live, food, water, and health care. In this way, the rules help protect the animals.
18.why: 后面说人们必须给动物干净的住处、食物，「这些规定保护了动物」，前面应是 A「动物园必须遵守规定」。

19.ev: They want to do more to protect the animals they love.
19.why: 后面说他们想做更多来保护动物，前面应是 D「有些人认为这些规定还不够」。

20.ev: They thought the zoos didn’t have enough space for the animals to show.

articles.src: 2024年信阳市浉河区中考三模
articles.title: How to color Easter Eggs (复活蛋)?
body: [图:reading/4e34fadb/image1.png]

How to color Easter Eggs (复活蛋)? Easter egg hunting is the most popular activity during the Easter holiday. It is enjoyed by both children and adults as they search for hidden eggs in gardens and parks. A fun and creative preparation activity for the whole family is coloring Easter eggs at home. Here is how:

Step 1: Boil the eggs.  [图:reading/4e34fadb/image2.png]Put the eggs in a pot of water. Make sure the water covers the eggs. Heat the water until it boils. Cover the pot and take it off the heat. Keep the eggs in the hot water for about 10 minutes and then take them out. Cool the eggs in an ice bath.

Step 2:Prepare the dyes (染料) Find a bowl that is large enough to hold the eggs. In this bowl, put in 0.5 cups of boiling water, 10 drops of food coloring for each egg and a little white vinegar (醋). Adding more drops of food coloring will result in a stronger color and the vinegar helps make the colors brighter!

Step 3: Color the eggs.  [图:reading/4e34fadb/image3.png]Put the eggs in the bowl and keep them fully in the water at least minutes. Turn them from time to time to make sure all sides get dyed. The longer you leave them in the dyes, the darker the color will be.

Step 4: Dry the eggs.  [图:reading/4e34fadb/image4.png]Place the eggs on paper to allow them to fully dry. If you plan to cat the eggs, keep them in the fridge. Don’t leave them out of the fridge for more than 2 hours.

qs.stem: What is the most popular activity during the Easter holiday?

ex.ev: Easter egg hunting is the most popular activity during the Easter holiday.
ex.why: 第一段原句：找复活蛋是复活节最受欢迎的活动，在花园、公园里找。

qs.stem: Why are eggs put in an ice bath?
opts: To help the eggs get dyed easily.

ex.ev: Cool the eggs in an ice bath.
ex.why: 鸡蛋刚从热水里拿出来，放进冰水是为了降温。

qs.stem: What can you do to make the color of the eggs brighter?
opts: Keeping the eggs in the dyes.
Adding white vinegar in the dyes.

ex.ev: and the vinegar helps make the colors brighter!
ex.why: 加白醋能让颜色更鲜亮；多加色素是让颜色更浓。

qs.stem: What gives the eggs a darker color?
opts: The time to dye the eggs.

ex.ev: The longer you leave them in the dyes, the darker the color will be.
ex.why: 在染料里泡得越久，颜色越深——是染色的时间。

qs.stem: Where is this passage most probably from?

ex.why: 一步一步教怎样给复活蛋染色，最可能是网页上的教程。

articles.src: 2024年信阳市浉河区中考三模
articles.title: Mr. Worth liked spending time with his grandson, Shawn.
body: Mr. Worth liked spending time with his grandson, Shawn. One day, Shawn came running into the house while his grandfather was visiting. He told his grandfather about a class science project that he was very excited about.
Each student was going to grow a pot of bean plants. When the plants grew big and strong, the students were to plant them in a garden at the school.

Shawn explained that his teacher taught them how to make the seeds grow. First, they put the seeds on a wet paper towel. Then, they put them near a warm window. When the seeds sprout (发芽), they are ready to be transplanted (移栽) into a pot.
After listening to his grandson, Mr. Worth said, “You can do just as you learned, but I want to show you one more thing about growing plants.”

“When I was a boy, my father showed me how to grow strong plants,” he continued. “When the plant is starting out, you put some weight on it.” Shawn looked at his grandfather in surprise. “Doesn’t the weight stop the bean from growing?” he asked. “No, of course not. This way, you will force the bean plant to be strong and healthy. If you give it everything it wants, it will grow too fast and it will be weak. It will fall over when the first big wind blows.”
Shawn listened carefully. He was eager (急切的) to grow the bean in the way grandfather described. He could hardly wait to tell his friends what he had learned that day.

qs.stem: Why did Shawn feel excited?
opts: Because his grandpa came to visit.
Because he had a class science project.
Because he could learn something new.

ex.ev: He told his grandfather about a class science project that he was very excited about.
ex.why: 他兴奋地跟爷爷讲班上的一个科学项目。

qs.stem: How many steps does Shawn need to grow bean seeds according to his teacher?

ex.ev: First, they put the seeds on a wet paper towel. Then, they put them near a warm window. When the seeds sprout (发芽), they are ready to be transplanted (移栽) into a pot.
ex.why: 老师教的是三步：放湿纸巾上、放到暖和的窗边、发芽后移栽进花盆。

qs.stem: Which words can best describe Mr. Worth?

ex.ev: “When I was a boy, my father showed me how to grow strong plants,” he continued.
ex.why: 爷爷耐心听孙子讲完，又教他小时候学到的种植经验——耐心、有经验。

qs.stem: What would happen next?
opts: Shawn would listen to his grandpa’s advice.
Shawn would grow the bean as his teacher said.

qs.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
