37.why: 空格是这一条的小标题，下面讲看到让你害怕的东西要告诉大人——A「看到不好的东西，告诉大人」。

38.ev: It's possible that people you meet online aren't really who they say they are.
38.why: 这一条讲不要见网友：他们可能不是自己说的那个人，B「在现实中去见他们可能很危险」。

39.ev: Not everything you read online is true.
39.why: 网上读到的不一定是真的，所以查资料要用可信的网站——E。

40.ev: It's easy to spend a lot of time in front of a screen.
40.why: 这一条讲合理用网：后面说「很容易在屏幕前花很多时间」，C「网上有那么多好玩有趣的事」正好引出这句。

articles.src: 2025年郑州市中考一模试卷
articles.title: In a small comfortable house near school，12-year-old Lily li
body: In a small comfortable house near school，12-year-old Lily lived happily with her mom.Lily had always liked her school.But this year，Lily did not want to go to school.One morning，she asked her mom， "Mom，can I be home-schooled？"

Her mom was surprised. "Why？I thought you loved school." Lily replied， "I did，but Emma，a girl in my class，keeps making fun of my eyes.She even got a couple of my friends to tease （嘲笑） me." Lily's eyes were crossed.

Her mom said gently， "Dear，that's really bad，but you know I can't stay at home all day.I have work to do." Seeing the disappointment on Lily's face，she continued， "If they don't stop，tell your teacher or let me call your teacher."
At school，Emma and the other girls continued to tease her.Lily didn't want to be a tattletale （告密者），so she tried hard to pay no attention to their mean words，but it seemed very difficult.
One evening，feeling upset，Lily shared her story on the school website.A week later，as Lily left school，she saw two girls holding bright signs with her name on them.

These two girls are also cross-eyed.Lily's heart raced as the two girls smiled and said， "We read your story and want you to join our group，the Cross-eyed Crew!" Lily could hardly believe her ears.She was happy to know she was not alone.

After that day，Lily joined the group.She spent time talking with her new friends and they joined school clubs together.Very soon，Lily even started some community activities with her group members.Slowly，her classmates began to join in the activities she organized and realized how kind and smart she was.And they felt happy to be friends with her.
Another morning，Lily told her mom that she didn't feel sorry about her eyes any more.She also said that true friends can make even the saddest days bright and full of hope.

qs.stem: Why didn't Lily want to go to school？ ________
opts: She had no friends at school.
Her teacher didn't care about her.
She wanted to stay with her mom.
Her classmates kept laughing at her.

ex.ev: keeps making fun of my eyes.She even got a couple of my friends to tease （嘲笑） me.
ex.why: Emma 一直取笑她的眼睛，还让她的朋友一起笑她。

qs.stem: What did Lily do to solve her problem step by step？ ________ a.Talked to her mom. b.Shared her story online. c.Joined the Cross-eyed Crew. d.Paid no attention to the teasing.

ex.why: 她先和妈妈说（a），在学校尽量不理会（d），在学校网站上分享了故事（b），最后加入了斗鸡眼小组（c）。

qs.stem: How did Lily make her classmates be friends with her？ ________
opts: By setting up a website for them.

ex.ev: Slowly，her classmates began to join in the activities she organized and realized how kind and smart she was.
ex.why: 她组织社区活动，同学们参加后发现她又善良又聪明，愿意和她做朋友。

qs.stem: What was Lily like at the end of the story？ ________

ex.ev: And they felt happy to be friends with her.
ex.why: 最后她积极参加社团、组织活动，同学们都乐意和她交朋友——积极、受欢迎。

qs.stem: What does the writer mainly want to tell us？ ________
opts: Our life is full of ups and downs.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of success.
Friendship and self-improvement can inspire each other.

ex.ev: She also said that true friends can make even the saddest days bright and full of hope.
ex.why: 朋友帮她走出阴影，她也变得更好，大家更喜欢她——友谊和自我提升相互促进。

articles.src: 2025年郑州外国语学校中考一模试卷
articles.title: Last fall，I signed up for a four-month program for teenagers
body: Last fall，I signed up for a four-month program for teenagers in Mountain High School.I went there because hikes，art and fields of corn sounded fun to me.
When I set out in August，I hugged my parents goodbye."See you in December!"I said.
My parents nodded.They were worried—I could tell.It was because they knew me so well.They knew that I had trouble reaching out.They knew that I was shy and I made friends slowly.
My dad looked worriedly at me and my mom's voice shook as she said，"You're going to be just fine，baby girl."

The first two weeks were difficult.I made half-hearted（不热心的）small talk at meals，and I cried in the shower.For me，being around people all the time was more tiring than a five-mile race.I was out of my comfort zone，and I couldn't go back.

One day during the third week，I spent two hours collecting corn with one of my classmates.My feelings matched the darkening sky.I wanted to be alone.After a while，she asked，"Where are you from again？"Half an hour passed，"How many brothers or sisters do you have？

Finally，my classmate said the three magic words in the English language：I LOVE READING.Soon I found myself talking about books I enjoyed reading.I started to relax.A few bricks（砖）fell down from my wall of shyness.

A few more fell.I started to reach out.The bricks fell and fell and fell.By the end of the program，I was totally different.I ran through the dining hall.I jumped on the chairs，I sang，and I made friends.
That was the wonderful thing about a comfort zone：once you are out of it，it doesn't take long to find a new normal.When I arrived，people tired me.When I left，I couldn't stand leaving them.

qs.stem: Why were the writer's parents worried about her？ ________
opts: Because she was always a shy girl.
Because she was afraid to leave home.
Because she was a very slow reader.

ex.ev: They knew that I was shy and I made friends slowly.
ex.why: 父母知道她害羞、交朋友慢，所以担心。

qs.stem: When did the writer start to relax？ ________

ex.ev: Soon I found myself talking about books I enjoyed reading.I started to relax.
ex.why: 聊起喜欢的书后，她开始放松了。

qs.stem: How did the writer's feelings change in the story？ ________

ex.ev: I went there because hikes，art and fields of corn sounded fun to me.
ex.why: 去之前觉得有趣，头两周很痛苦，聊书后放松，最后满怀希望地交到朋友——有兴趣→痛苦→放松→有希望。

qs.stem: What did the writer learn from the program？ ________
opts: The advantages of living by oneself.
The joy of leaving a comfort zone.
The value of having a new hobby.

ex.ev: That was the wonderful thing about a comfort zone：once you are out of it，it doesn't take long to find a new normal.
ex.why: 她体会到走出舒适区的美好。

qs.stem: What's the best title for the text？ ________
opts: The friendship of two shy girls.
Stepping out of my comfort zone.

ex.ev: I was out of my comfort zone，and I couldn't go back.
ex.why: 全文讲她怎样走出舒适区——「走出我的舒适区」。

cand: n. 十三至十九岁青少年

articles.src: 2025年郑州市中考二模试卷
articles.title: One day，Wolf found a big field-a good place to grow food for
body: One day，Wolf found a big field-a good place to grow food for his family.But he knew it was hard work.If he had a big，strong animal as a partner，he wouldn't have to work so hard.Where could he find one？Just then Bear walked by.Wolf knew he was the perfect partner.
"Morning，Bear，"Wolf said，in his kindest voice."See that field？Why not plant food for our families together？"
"OK，"said Bear."I'll bring the seeds（种子）."
They decided to meet the next day.But Wolf wanted to make sure the best food would belong to him，not Bear.He decided to play a trick （花招）.
The next morning，Wolf said， "Let's divide the fruit first.I'll take all that grows above ground，and you take all below."
"Sounds fair，"replied Bear.

Soon the field was cleared and they began planting seeds.For weeks，they kept cutting grass and watering the ground.Finally，Wolf got the green tops while Bear dug out some dirty round things."Bear's half is so ugly compared to mine!How clever I am!"Wolf started home，smiling.
Weeks later，Wolf met Bear."What seeds did we plant？"he asked."My family didn't like them."
Bear smiled， "They are potatoes and my family loved them."
"It's unfair，"said Wolf."Let's plant again."
He repeated the trick， "I get the below-ground part.You have that above."
"Agreed，"said Bear."I'll bring the seeds."
The seeds grew well.When the fruit was ready，they agreed to harvest（收获）together.
But Bear started earlier in order to get his part before Wolf realized the fact.When Wolf arrived，he was surprised to find Bear already there.
"Morning，"called Bear."I start early so that you can dig quicker.I've taken my part.Now it's your turn."
Wolf dug excitedly but found no potatoes.
"Bear!What did we plant this time？"
"Corn!"Bear headed home.

qs.stem: Why did Wolf want a partner？ ________
opts: He wanted to share the hard work.
He couldn't afford the big field himself.

ex.ev: If he had a big，strong animal as a partner，he wouldn't have to work so hard.
ex.why: 种地很辛苦，有个强壮的伙伴他就不用那么累——想有人分担辛苦活儿。

qs.stem: What trick did Wolf play？ ________

ex.ev: I'll take all that grows above ground，and you take all below.
ex.why: 狼抢先说「地上的归我，地下的归你」——他的花招是先挑。

qs.stem: How did Bear deal with the trick when they planted again？ ________
opts: By dividing the fruit in half.
By asking his family for help.
By growing plants good for him.
By taking turns to harvest the fruit.

ex.ev: "Corn!"Bear headed home.
ex.why: 第二次狼要地下的，熊就种玉米（果实长在地上）——种对自己有利的作物。

qs.stem: In what order does the story develop？ ________

ex.why: 故事按第一次种地、几周后、第二次种地、收获的时间顺序展开。

qs.stem: What can we learn from the story？ ________
opts: Good luck is fair to everyone.
Hard work will finally bring fruits.
Honesty is necessary to get on with others.
Friendship is like a plant that needs watering.

ex.ev: But Wolf wanted to make sure the best food would belong to him，not Bear.He decided to play a trick （花招）.
ex.why: 狼耍花招想占便宜，结果两次都吃亏——和别人相处要诚实。

cand: adj. 不公平的；不公正的

articles.src: 2025年郑州市中考二模试卷
articles.title: If you put two bottles of water-one hot and the other cold，i
body: If you put two bottles of water-one hot and the other cold，in a fridge，which will freeze（结冰） quicker？The cold water，right？But in fact，the hot water most probably freezes first.Strange，isn't it？Scientists call it the Mpemba effect（效应）.

Once Erasto Mpemba，a school boy，was making ice cream in a cooking class.He was surprised to find that a heated mix froze more quickly than a cold one.He wondered why this happened.When Osborne，a university scientist，came to the school，he asked him about it.It seemed so unbelievable that his classmates laughed at him for asking such a stupid question，but Osborne took it seriously.He suggested that they work together to find out why.They tested many times by using water with temperatures from 25℃ to 90℃，and found that the higher the water temperature was，the less time it took the water to freeze.It means water at 25℃ takes the longest time to freeze and water at 90℃ takes the shortest.

What causes this effect？Some scientists think that the gas（气体） leaves water as water heats up，which makes it freeze quicker.Other scientists think differently.They say water in a bottle keeps moving，with hot water rising and cold water going down.This convection is stronger in the hotter bottle，which makes hot water lose heat faster than cold water.

Last winter，the Mpemba effect became popular online.Many people went to Harbin and threw hot water into the freezing air.The hot water would turn to ice at once，allowing people to enjoy the beautiful ice mist （薄雾） in the air.People took videos of this process and put them on the Internet.

qs.stem: What is the Mpemba effect？ ________

ex.ev: But in fact，the hot water most probably freezes first.Strange，isn't it？Scientists call it the Mpemba effect（效应）.
ex.why: 热水比冷水先结冰，科学家把这个发现叫姆潘巴效应——是一项科学发现。

qs.stem: Which of the following can show Mpemba and Osborne's discovery？ ________

ex.ev: and found that the higher the water temperature was，the less time it took the water to freeze.
ex.why: 水温越高，结冰用时越短，A 图是向下的曲线。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word"convection"mean？ ________
opts: The movement of heat in water.
The weight of the water bottle.

ex.ev: They say water in a bottle keeps moving，with hot water rising and cold water going down.
ex.why: 瓶子里热水上升、冷水下沉，这种运动叫 convection——热在水里的流动（对流）。

qs.stem: What purpose does the last paragraph serve？ ________
opts: It leads to the main idea of the whole text.
It calls on teenagers to have a try in winter.
It offers a solution to Mpemba's question at school.
It provides an example of the Mpemba effect in real life.

ex.ev: Many people went to Harbin and threw hot water into the freezing air.
ex.why: 最后一段讲在哈尔滨泼水成冰，是姆潘巴效应在生活中的例子。

qs.stem: What's the best title for the text？ ________

ex.ev: If you put two bottles of water-one hot and the other cold，in a fridge，which will freeze（结冰） quicker？
ex.why: 全文讲热水和冷水谁先结冰——「水的结冰比赛」。

articles.src: 2025年郑州市中考二模试卷
articles.title: Have you noticed how the lines in the books you read help yo
body: Have you noticed how the lines in the books you read help you see things differently？（32）________ They can lead you to new ways of experiencing the world around you.

（33）________ From answering questions at school to talking with your family，words are wonderful tools for communication with people around you.At the same time，words also help to communicate with yourself.

A proper way to talk to yourself through words is keeping a diary.It can increase your happiness.（34）________ And recording failures on the page can be a great way to avoid the same mistakes next time，which also makes you feel good.

Sadness，anger，and fear come and go.When you have these big emotions（情绪），your heart beats fast and it's hard to know what to do in those moments.Then writing about feelings，situations and experiences helps manage the emotions.Putting the story down in a diary helps to find out what you are feeling.It's called"naming".（35）________

When you write a diary，you're writing for yourself.The focus is on what you think and feel，rather than getting things right or sounding clever.It's more important to let your story and feelings out.（36）________ This writing is for you alone and the process（过程） is more important than how clear or correct it is.

opts: This is the magical force of words.
You needn't care about the rules of writing.
You may know what to do next by naming the story.
Keeping your success in a diary brings much pleasure.
Learning to express thoughts and feelings is a big part of life.

32.ev: They can lead you to new ways of experiencing the world around you.
32.why: 书里的句子让你换个角度看事情，A「这就是文字的神奇力量」。

33.ev: From answering questions at school to talking with your family，words are wonderful tools for communication with people around you.
33.why: 这一段讲用文字和别人、和自己交流，开头 E「学会表达想法和感受是生活的重要部分」。

34.why: 写日记能增加快乐，D「把成功记进日记带来很多快乐」，后面再说记录失败。

35.ev: Putting the story down in a diary helps to find out what you are feeling.It's called"naming".
35.why: 这叫「命名」，C「给事情命名，你可能就知道接下来怎么做了」。

36.ev: It's more important to let your story and feelings out.
36.why: 日记是写给自己的，B「不用在乎写作规则」。

articles.src: 2025年实验中学中考一模试卷
articles.title: In our daily life，people like to invite friends to celebrate
body: In our daily life，people like to invite friends to celebrate some special events together.But sometimes we've got some other plans already and have to refuse their invitations.So do you know how to express your refusal politely？Here are some examples.

Dear Rebecca，    Thank you for inviting me to your 18th birthday party.Next Thursday，I will sing one song for you with all my heart and soul："Happy birthday!"    Although I really want to be part of the event，please accept my apologies（道歉）.I will go to China for a meeting on that day，so I send you this gift and will visit you when I'm back in New York.Happy18th birthday!                                                                                                                                                         Yours，                                                                                                                                                      Ms.Miller

Dear Mr.Williams，    I am writing this letter to thank you for the invitation on June 30th，but I'm sorry I can't go to your 25th wedding anniversary（周年）.German exams have been changed to that day，so I have to spend the whole day on them.I'd like to express my best wishes to you and Mrs.Williams.                                                                                                                                                 Best wishes，                                                                                                                                                              Jeff

Dear Peter，    Thank you for the invitation to your daughter's graduation（毕业）party.I know how proud you are.But I've already booked a ticket to fly to New York on June 7th to visit my sister Kate.She has been ill for days.Please congratulate（祝贺）Anna for me and let her know I'll be there in spirit.                                                                                                                                                            Yous，                                                                                                                                                          Andrew

Dear George，    Congratulations on your new job!I wish I could go to the party and celebrate with you，but I must be out of town this weekend.Maybe we can get together next Monday，and you can tell me all about your new job.I wish you the best!                                                                                                                                                            Jenna

qs.stem: What will Ms.Miller do next Thursday？ ________

ex.ev: I will go to China for a meeting on that day，
ex.why: Ms. Miller 下周四要去中国开会。

qs.stem: How will Andrew go to New York？ ________

ex.ev: But I've already booked a ticket to fly to New York on June 7th to visit my sister Kate.
ex.why: Andrew 订了飞往纽约的机票（fly），C 图是飞机。

qs.stem: How long has Mr.Williams been married？ ________

ex.ev: but I'm sorry I can't go to your 25th wedding anniversary（周年）.
ex.why: 结婚 25 周年纪念日，结婚 25 年了。

qs.stem: Who might live in New York？ ________ ①Kate②Ms.Miller③Peter④Rebecca

ex.ev: so I send you this gift and will visit you when I'm back in New York.
ex.why: Kate 在纽约；Ms. Miller 说「回纽约后去看你（Rebecca）」，两人都在纽约。Peter 住哪没提——①②④。

qs.stem: What can we learn from the passage？ ________
opts: George may meet Jenna this Sunday.
Jeff sent an invitation to Mr.Williams.

ex.ev: Thank you for inviting me to your 18th birthday party.Next Thursday，
ex.why: Rebecca 下周四才过 18 岁生日，所以她现在 17 岁。找到新工作的是 George；Jenna 约的是下周一；Jeff 是收到邀请的人。

cand: adj. 生病的；身体不适的

articles.src: 2025年郑州市经开外国语学校中考一调试卷
articles.title: Summer holiday is coming soon!
body: Summer holiday is coming soon!Many of you may go travelling to relax.Making a good travel video can help you to record your wonderful experiences and you can also share it with your friends and classmates.To make a good travel video，here's a simple guide：     Planning：Before your trip，think about what you want to record.List the places you'll visit and what makes them special.     ____________：Use a good camera or a smartphone.Bring more than one battery（电池） and memory card.It's better to bring a stabilizer（稳定器），because it can help avoid shaking when you are recording.     Filming：When you're filming，try to record both big scenes and small facts.Film interesting things like nature，local food，or street life.Remember to keep your videos short and interesting.     Storytelling：Your video should tell a story.Think about beginning with an introduction，then showing your journey，and ending with a wonderful closing shot.     Editing：After filming，use editing software（剪辑软件） to put what you film together.You can add music to make your video better.What's more，you can even add some English subtitles（字幕），which may help foreigners understand your video and can also help you practise your English writing.     Sharing：Once your video is ready，share it with friends and classmates or on social media.Get people's opinions to improve your next video.     Remember，the best travel videos show your special experiences and stories.Have fun and be creative!

qs.stem: What should you do before your trip to make a good travel video？ ________

ex.ev: Planning：Before your trip，think about what you want to record.
ex.why: 出发前，想好要拍什么。

qs.stem: What is the most possible missing part for the         ？ ________

ex.ev: Use a good camera or a smartphone.Bring more than one battery（电池） and memory card.
ex.why: 这一条讲带相机、电池、存储卡、稳定器——要带的东西。

qs.stem: How can you make your travel video more interesting？ ________
opts: By filming both big scenes and small facts.
By using only one kind of shot.

ex.ev: When you're filming，try to record both big scenes and small facts.
ex.why: 拍大场景也拍小细节，视频才有意思。

qs.stem: Why is it good to add English subtitles to your travel video？ ________
opts: Because it makes the video longer and more interesting.
Because it helps foreigners understand your video.
Because subtitles are required for all travel videos.
Because it takes the place of the need for music.

ex.ev: which may help foreigners understand your video
ex.why: 加英文字幕能帮外国人看懂。

qs.stem: The passage is written for  ________.

ex.ev: Summer holiday is coming soon!Many of you may go travelling to relax.
ex.why: 说暑假快到了、能练英语写作、分享给同学，是写给学生的。

cand: n. 大众传播媒介；媒体

articles.src: 2025年郑州市中原区名校联盟中考二模试卷
articles.title: Steve was excited about school on Monday morning.
body: Steve was excited about school on Monday morning.The teacher had announced a week ago that their class would host a talent show this week.Everyone was encouraged to perform something special.
"What will you do，Steve？" asked his best friend Jerry during lunch.

Steve smiled but said nothing.The truth was，he didn't know what talent he could show.Jerry was going to juggle （玩杂技抛接） three balls in the air，and Emily was going to play the violin.Steve felt he wasn't good at anything.

That night，Steve sat on the sofa，staring at the family guitar.His dad used to play it before he got too busy with work. "Maybe I could learn one song，" Steve thought.He picked up the guitar and played a few sounds.It sounded terrible. "Need help？" Dad appeared at the door with a smile.
"Yes!" Steve said excitedly.

Dad sat next to Steve and showed him how to hold the guitar properly. "Press your fingers here，" Dad said，pointing to the strings （弦）. "Now，try again." Steve pressed down hard and played.This time，the sound was a little better，but still not great.

For the next week，Dad spent an hour teaching Steve a simple song.They laughed when Steve hit the wrong notes，and Dad told stories about how he learned to play when he was a boy.Seven days later，Steve could finally play the song.He smiled as the last note rang out. "I did it，Dad!" he said proudly.

On the day of the talent show，the classroom was full of excitement.Jerry's juggling act got loud applause （掌声），and Emily's violin performance was beautiful.When it was Steve's turn，he carried the guitar nervously to the front.
He started playing，his fingers shaking.But by the second verse （节），he got confidence.Suddenly，the room was filled with cheers.Steve even heard Jerry shout， "That's amazing!"
After the show，Steve's teacher patted （拍） him on the back. "I didn't know you could play the guitar，Steve!"
"Neither did I，" Steve said with a laugh.

For the first time，Steve realized that talent wasn't about being the best or perfect—it was about trying，about sharing a piece of yourself with others.The talent show wasn't the end of something；it was the beginning.

qs.stem: What was Steve's problem at the beginning？ ________
opts: He was too busy to practice.
He couldn't find a talent to show.
He didn't want to perform at the talent show.

ex.ev: The truth was，he didn't know what talent he could show.
ex.why: 他不知道自己能表演什么才艺。

qs.stem: How did Steve's father help him？ ________
opts: By writing a song for him.
By teaching him step by step.

ex.ev: Dad sat next to Steve and showed him how to hold the guitar properly.
ex.why: 爸爸一步步教他怎么拿吉他、怎么按弦，每天教一小时。

qs.stem: What is the correct order of these events？ ________ a.Steve learned to play a simple song. b.Steve and his friends talked about the talent show. c.Steve played the guitar confidently on stage. d.Steve felt nervous about his performance.

ex.why: 顺序：和朋友聊才艺表演（b）→ 学会一首简单的歌（a）→ 上台前紧张（d）→ 自信地弹完（c）。

qs.stem: How did Steve's feelings change during the story？ ________

ex.ev: "I did it，Dad!" he said proudly.
ex.why: 开始很兴奋开心，上台时紧张，最后为自己骄傲——开心→紧张→骄傲。

qs.stem: What's the best title for the text？ ________

ex.ev: For the first time，Steve realized that talent wasn't about being the best or perfect—it was about trying，
ex.why: Steve 从「不知道自己会什么」到找到才艺——「找到我自己的才艺」。

articles.src: 2025年新乡市中考一模试卷
articles.title: Henan Province，located in central China，is one of the most p
body: Henan Province，located in central China，is one of the most popular provinces in China.Here are some beautiful places of interest which you can visit in Henan Province.

[图:reading/f65af12b/image1.png] Henan Museum   Opening hours：9：00 a.m.to 5：00 p.m. Attention：You must enter the museum one hour before the closing time.Henan Museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday all year round. Address：No.8，Nongye Road，Jinshui District，Zhengzhou City Bus：Bus 2/Bus 11/Bus 18/Bus 102/... Subway：Line 2—Guanhutun Station

[图:reading/f65af12b/image2.png] Shaolin Temple   Opening hours：7：00 a.m.to 5：00 p.m. Tickets：¥80 for adults；¥40 for students Attention：Don't miss the wonderful kung fu performance! Free for kids under 6 years old or old people over 60 years old Address：West Foothills of Songshan Mountain，Dengfeng City Bus：Bus 8

[图:reading/f65af12b/image3.png] Longmen Grottoes   Opening hours：8：00 a.m.to 6：00 p.m. Attention：You must enter the Longmen Grottoes one hour before the closing time. Tickets：¥90 for adults；¥45 for 13 to 18 years old Attention：Free for kids under 12 years old or old people over 60 years old. Address：Longmen Town，Luolong District，Luoyang City Bus：Bus 53/Bus 81

qs.stem: Who is the text mainly written for？ ________

ex.ev: Here are some beautiful places of interest which you can visit in Henan Province.
ex.why: 介绍河南几个可以去游玩的景点，是写给游客的。

qs.stem: If Lily wants to have a trip by subway，she can visit   ________.

ex.ev: Subway：Line 2—Guanhutun Station
ex.why: 三个景点里只有河南博物院写了地铁线路。

qs.stem: What can we know from the text？ ________
opts: We can visit the Henan Museum on Mondays.
We can watch folk performances in Dengfeng.
We can enter the Longmen Grottoes at 6：00 p.m.
We can take a bus to any of the three places.

ex.ev: Attention：Don't miss the wonderful kung fu performance!
ex.why: 少林寺在登封，可以看精彩的功夫表演。河南博物院周一不开；龙门石窟要在闭园前一小时入园，下午 6 点进不去。

qs.stem: How much do Mr and Mrs Smith（both in their forties）need to pay if they want to visit the Longmen Grottoes with their 11-year-old daughter？ ________

ex.ev: Tickets：¥90 for adults；¥45 for 13 to 18 years old Attention：Free for kids under 12 years old
ex.why: 父母各 90 元，11 岁的女儿不到 12 岁免费：90 × 2 = 180 元。

qs.stem: What's the main purpose of the text？ ________
opts: To give a short introduction to Henan Province.
To show the traditional culture of Henan Province.
To introduce some places of interest in Henan Province.
To list special tips on how to save money when traveling.

ex.ev: Here are some beautiful places of interest which you can visit in Henan Province.
ex.why: 文章目的是介绍河南的几个名胜古迹。

articles.src: 2025年新乡市中考一模试卷
articles.title: Andy was a quiet and common student who felt like he was jus
body: Andy was a quiet and common student who felt like he was just a small part of the class.He had friends，but they always seemed closer to others than to him.This made Andy feel like nobody cared about him.

One day，he read an advice column （专栏）by David House，a writer who helped solve problems for students.David said that even though he was shy and lonely in school，he would finally find his place.This gave Andy an idea.
Andy decided to join the school's photography club.He loved taking photos but never thought he was good enough to show them to others.But this time he took a chance and signed up.

At first，Andy was shy and didn't talk much in the club.But as he started catching beautiful moments with his camera，he found that he had a talent for it.His classmates started to notice his photos and even asked him for advice.

Slowly，Andy's confidence grew.He started to talk more and make new friends who shared a common interest in photography.They organized a small photo exhibition（展览），and when Andy's photos were shown on it，he felt proud and happy.
Even his teachers noticed the changes about Andy.They praised his creativity and encouraged him to keep exploring his talent.Andy realized that he didn't have to be outgoing to be important.
Actually，he just needed to be true to himself and do what he loved.

From then on，Andy felt like he became happier than before at school.He was proud of his photography and happy to have found a group of friends who appreciated it.His story showed that everyone has a special talent，and with courage and determination，we can all find our place in the world.

qs.stem: Why did Andy feel like nobody cared about him at first？ ________
opts: Because he was not good at studying.
Because his friends seemed closer to others.
Because he was not interested in school activities.
Because he was quiet and didn't want to make friends.

ex.ev: He had friends，but they always seemed closer to others than to him.
ex.why: 他有朋友，但朋友们总是和别人更亲近，所以他觉得没人在乎他。

qs.stem: Which club did Andy join after reading David House's advice column？ ________

ex.ev: Andy decided to join the school's photography club.
ex.why: 他决定加入学校的摄影社。

qs.stem: What happened after Andy's classmates saw his photos at first？ ________
opts: They became the fans of Andy at once.
They didn't care about the photos completely.
They thought Andy was showing off his photography skills.
They started noticing the photos and asked him for advice.

ex.ev: His classmates started to notice his photos and even asked him for advice.
ex.why: 同学们开始注意他的照片，还向他请教。

qs.stem: Which of the following words can best describe Andy？ ________

ex.ev: Andy realized that he didn't have to be outgoing to be important.
ex.why: Andy 很安静，但有摄影天赋——安静却有才华。

qs.stem: What is the best title of the text？ ________
opts: Andy's Journey to Finding His Place
David House's Advice for Shy Students
The Power of Friends and Social Connections

ex.ev: we can all find our place in the world.
ex.why: 全文讲 Andy 怎样找到自己的位置——「Andy 寻找自己位置的旅程」。

articles.src: 2025年新乡市中考一模试卷
articles.title: How many fathers usually come to the parent-teacher meetings
body: How many fathers usually come to the parent-teacher meetings of your class？You might have noticed that not many dads are there.（36）________

On August 24th，a school in Hangzhou did something really cool.It had a parent-teacher meeting，but this time，only dads were invited!（37）________In this way，the school hoped that dads could take more part in family education.

In the last few years，people have been talking about the fact that fathers are missing from family education.According to a survey by the All-China Women's Federation and National Bureau of Statistics，most moms in China help their kids with homework.（38）________However，dads and moms both play important roles in their children's education.

"Dads can shape young kids' personalities（个性），"said Luo Xuepeng from Guangdong.He is a father of a 9-year-old boy."A calm and strong dad can help kids form good habits and become more outgoing，"he added.
（39）________If laws give dads more time to care for and spend more time with their kids，things will get better.
So，the"dads only"meeting is a great idea.（40）________Let's hope more schools have"dads only"meetings too!

opts: About 68 out of 100 moms do this at home.
It will encourage more dads to join in their kids' education more often.
Of course，dads can't fix everything by themselves for their kids.
Have you ever thought of a"dads only"parent-teacher meeting？
Also，dads were not allowed to make an excuse （借口）to miss the meeting.

36.ev: You might have noticed that not many dads are there.
36.why: 家长会上爸爸不多，接着问 D「你想过「只有爸爸参加」的家长会吗？」引出下文。

37.ev: It had a parent-teacher meeting，but this time，only dads were invited!
37.why: 只邀请爸爸，E「而且爸爸不许找借口不来」，Also 补充。

38.ev: most moms in China help their kids with homework.
38.why: 大多数妈妈辅导作业，A「每 100 个妈妈里约 68 个这样做」给出数字。

39.ev: If laws give dads more time to care for and spend more time with their kids，things will get better.
39.why: 后面说如果法律给爸爸更多时间情况会更好，前面应是 C「当然，爸爸一个人也不能解决孩子所有问题」。

40.ev: So，the"dads only"meeting is a great idea.
40.why: 「只有爸爸的家长会」是个好主意，B「它会鼓励更多爸爸更常参与孩子的教育」。

articles.src: 2025年洛阳偃师中成外国语学校中考一模
articles.title: Sandra opened her eyes and jumped out of bed.
body: Sandra opened her eyes and jumped out of bed. Most days she hated getting up early. But today was different. Sandra was wide awake and excited. Her family was going on a hike (徒步旅行)! This was Sandra’s first hike. She put on her new shoes and was ready to go.

After two hours’ driving, Sandra’s family came to the hiking trail (路径). It was a dirt trail that went into the forest. Sandra, her mother, and her brother James began to walk. Butterflies and bees flew over the flowers. At first the bees made Sandra nervous, but soon she saw that they were more interested in the flowers than they were in her.

James had hiked this trail before. He talked about his last hiking experience. Sandra wanted to talk, but she felt out of breath. The trail was steep (陡峭的). They had been walking up the hill for an hour by now.
“I’m tired,” Sandra said.
“Come on, Sandra,” said James. “You can do it! You’re fifteen years old. That’s old enough to hike.”

Sandra kept going. If her brother said she could do it, Sandra knew she could. They kept walking. Sandra looked around at the plants to keep her mind off of how tired she felt. There was green everywhere. There were trees with long leaves that Sandra had never seen before. She even saw a small rabbit by the side of the trail.

“Look, Sandra!” her brother called suddenly. The trail ended. They were at a pool at the bottom of a waterfall. Sandra looked up at the water rushing down. How amazing! “Congratulations, Sandra!” said her mother. “You’ve just finished your first hike!” Sandra smiled. She decided that she liked hiking.

qs.stem: What do we know about Sandra from?
opts: She wanted a new pair of shoes.
She got up early in excitement for the hike.

ex.ev: Most days she hated getting up early. But today was different. Sandra was wide awake and excited.
ex.why: 平时讨厌早起，今天因为要去徒步，兴奋得早早醒了。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “they” refer to?

ex.ev: At first the bees made Sandra nervous, but soon she saw that they were more interested in the flowers than they were in her.
ex.why: they 指前面让她紧张的蜜蜂：它们对花比对她更感兴趣。

qs.stem: How did James’ words in Paragraph 5 work on Sandra?
opts: They made her feel proud of herself.
They made her think of some good memories.

ex.ev: If her brother said she could do it, Sandra knew she could.
ex.why: 哥哥说「你能行」，她就坚持走下去了——哥哥的话鼓励了她。

qs.stem: How did Sandra keep her mind off of her tiredness?
opts: By playing with a small rabbit.
By enjoying beautiful scenes around her.
By talking with her mother and brother all the way.

ex.ev: Sandra looked around at the plants to keep her mind off of how tired she felt.
ex.why: 她看周围的植物、绿树、小兔子，忘了累——欣赏身边的美景。

qs.stem: What do you learn from the passage?
opts: Sandra has a special hiking trail.
There’s a dream, it comes true soon.
Sticking to doing anything can bring success.

ex.ev: “You’ve just finished your first hike!”
ex.why: 累了也坚持，最后看到美丽的瀑布、完成第一次徒步——坚持就能成功。

articles.src: 2025年洛阳偃师中成外国语学校中考一模
articles.title: Whether you’re a junior or a senior, developing the followin
body: Whether you’re a junior or a senior, developing the following skills will help you achieve success in school and in life.

Time management. There are just 24 hours in each day.     16     High-school students have about 35 hours’ class time per week. So you should be wise in managing time, which helps you make full use of each day.

Good study habits.     17     If not, there’s still time to develop them. Good study habits include the following: ① Always be prepared for class, and attend classes on time. ②Finish homework in time. Only when your homework is finished can you have free time to do other things.     18    ③Set aside (留出) quiet time each day for study, even if you don’t have homework or a test the next day.

Good note taking. You can’t possibly write down everything the teacher says since we talk at a speed of about 225 words per minute.     19     Note-taking should be in a way which is the most helpful to you. For example, you can try writing notes on different colored cards. You can compare your notes with your classmates’ to learn from them. If you really have a problem with note-taking, you might ask your teacher if you can record daily lessons. Do whatever it takes!
20     Review your notes daily rather than study for tests the night before. Go over your notes each day while the lecture (讲课) is still fresh in your mind and add any missing pieces.
As time goes by, you’ll improve your learning and build towards your final goal: to master the subject or skill.

opts: If you’ve got them, it’s great.
How you do with that time makes the difference.
But you do need to write down the important materials.

16.ev: There are just 24 hours in each day.
16.why: 每天只有 24 小时，D「怎样用这些时间才是关键」。

17.ev: If not, there’s still time to develop them.
17.why: 后面说「如果没有，还来得及培养」，前面应是 C「如果你有好习惯，那很好」。

18.ev: Only when your homework is finished can you have free time to do other things.
18.why: 作业做完才有空做别的，B「所以先写作业」。

19.ev: You can’t possibly write down everything the teacher says
19.why: 不可能记下老师说的每句话，E「但一定要记下重要内容」。

20.ev: Review your notes daily rather than study for tests the night before.
20.why: 这一条的小标题，下面讲每天复习笔记——A「每天复习笔记」。

cand: pron. 无论什么；任何事物

articles.src: 2025年郑州市登封市中考一模
articles.title: In the 13th century, the famous Italian traveler, Marco Polo
body: In the 13th century, the famous Italian traveler, Marco Polo, traveled a long way to China. During his stay in China, he saw many wonderful things.     16     In western countries, people did not use paper money until the 15th century. However, people in China began to use paper money in the 7th century.
A Chinese man called Cai Lun invented paper almost 2,000 years ago. He made it from wood.     17     He then put these pieces of paper together and made them into a book.

Now paper still comes from trees. We use a lot of paper every day. If we keep on wasting so much paper, there will not be any trees left on the earth. If there are no trees, there will be no paper. Every day, people throw away about 2,800 tons (吨) of paper in our city.     18     This means that we are cutting nearly 48,000 trees every day.
Since it takes more than 10 years for a tree to grow, we must start using less paper now. If we don’t, we will not have enough time to grow more trees to take the place of those we use for paper.

19     We can use both sides of every piece of paper, especially when we are making notes. We can choose drinks in bottles. We can also use cotton handkerchiefs (手帕), but not paper ones.     20     If the shop assistant (店员) does give us a paper bag, we can save it and reuse it later.
Everyone can help to save paper. If we all think carefully, we can help protect trees. But we should do it now, before it is too late.

opts: So how can we save paper?
It takes 17 trees to make one ton of paper.
When we go shopping, we can use fewer paper bags.
He took the wood from the tree and made it into paper.
One of the things he discovered was that the Chinese used paper money.

16.ev: In western countries, people did not use paper money until the 15th century.
16.why: 马可·波罗看到很多奇妙的东西，E「其中之一是中国人用纸币」，后面接着讲纸币。

17.ev: He made it from wood.
17.why: 蔡伦用木头造纸，D「他把树上的木头做成纸」，后面接着把纸订成书。

18.ev: This means that we are cutting nearly 48,000 trees every day.
18.why: 每天扔 2800 吨纸，B「造一吨纸要 17 棵树」，所以每天砍约 48000 棵树。

19.ev: We can use both sides of every piece of paper, especially when we are making notes.
19.why: 这一段讲具体怎么省纸，开头先问 A「那我们怎样节约用纸呢？」

20.ev: If the shop assistant (店员) does give us a paper bag, we can save it and reuse it later.
20.why: 后面说店员给了纸袋就留着再用，前面应是 C「购物时可以少用纸袋」。

articles.src: 2025年师范大学附属中学中考一模
articles.title: Four boys sat in the headmaster’s office, waiting for their
body: Four boys sat in the headmaster’s office, waiting for their punishment. They were in big trouble and they knew it.

When the headmaster came in, he told the boys, “I’ve just spoken to all your parents on the phone. They have allowed me to punish you in whatever way I see fit. You have caused a lot of extra work for our cleaner by writing on the walls today. But he won’t do the cleaning. It’s your duty now. That is to say, you boys will clean the walls every day after school for the next week.”
After school that day, the boys went to the cleaner. He looked at them, and without a word, he pointed to some buckets (桶) of water, soap and brushes.
The work took a long time. Whenever they thought they had cleaned enough, the cleaner would point out somewhere they had missed. But he never spoke.

On the last day, they finally finished the job. But when they was about to leave, the cleaner spoke. “In the country where I grew up, we hardly had books or teachers. Even to get a new pencil was a big thing,” he said.

“You used pencils to write on the walls. A pencil is like a person. For a person, there is the point on the outside, but what does the work is inside,” he explained. “Every once in a while, you have to get a painful sharpening (削尖). That is what you’ve had this week,” he said. “From now on, instead of leaving your mark on the walls, leave your mark on life. Write your own story using what’s inside you.”          The boys understood and they never wrote on any walls again.

qs.stem: What did the headmaster do to punish the four boys?
opts: Asked the cleaner to punish them.
Told them to go back home.
Ordered them to clean the walls.

ex.ev: That is to say, you boys will clean the walls every day after school for the next week.
ex.why: 校长罚他们接下来一周每天放学后擦墙。

qs.stem: What did the cleaner think of the four boys’ work according to Paragraph 4?

ex.ev: Whenever they thought they had cleaned enough, the cleaner would point out somewhere they had missed.
ex.why: 他们以为擦完了，清洁工总能指出漏掉的地方——他觉得他们干得粗心。

qs.stem: What can be inferred about the cleaner’s childhood?
opts: He grew up in a wealthy family.
He valued the chance to receive education.

ex.ev: “In the country where I grew up, we hardly had books or teachers. Even to get a new pencil was a big thing,”
ex.why: 他小时候几乎没有书和老师，连一支新铅笔都是大事——可以推断他很珍惜受教育的机会。

qs.stem: What did the cleaner hope the four boys to do after this experience?
opts: They would do the cleaning every day.
They would write down their stories.

ex.ev: “From now on, instead of leaving your mark on the walls, leave your mark on life. Write your own story using what’s inside you.”
ex.why: 他用铅笔比喻人：要靠内在的东西在人生中留下印记——希望孩子们培养好品格。

qs.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
opts: A Week of Cleaning the Walls
The Punishment that Taught a Lesson

ex.ev: The boys understood and they never wrote on any walls again.
ex.why: 一次惩罚让孩子们明白了道理，再也不乱写了——「教会道理的惩罚」。

cand: pron. 无论什么；任何事物

articles.src: 2025年师范大学附属中学中考一模
articles.title: Months later, you will go into a new environment.
body: Months later, you will go into a new environment. When you step into a new environment, you must have a strong wish to fit in.     16     Here is some advice that can help you.

Be confident. Confidence attracts(吸引) most people. Everyone is special and there is only one person like you in this world.     17     If so, you will be able to build up confidence step by step. You won’t have much difficulty fitting in.

Be kind to everyone.     18     When people notice your kindness, they will return it one day. Always give more than you receive, and think more of others than of yourself. A person who cares for others is popular everywhere.

19     Different kinds of activities like playing football can help you to be known to others. You may add more friends to your circle. At the same time, you’ll be amazed to see how much they like you. Instead of being alone to waste time, go out to dance and sing together with others to develop friendship.

Be optimistic(乐观的). Optimism makes both you and others feel pleased. It makes a good first impression.     20     Humor catches others’ attention as well. People will like you for making them live happily.
If you follow what is mentioned above, you will be accepted by people around you. As a result, you will fit in very well and enjoy your new life.

opts: Kindness is the bridge to your own happiness.
A pleasant smile costs the least and does the most.
Spend some time thinking about your strong points.
Fitting in means you want to make more friends and get more chances to live a happier life.

16.ev: When you step into a new environment, you must have a strong wish to fit in.
16.why: 到新环境要融入，E「融入意味着交更多朋友、有更多机会过得更快乐」。

17.ev: If so, you will be able to build up confidence step by step.
17.why: 后面说「这样你就能一步步建立自信」，前面应是 D「花点时间想想自己的优点」。

18.ev: When people notice your kindness, they will return it one day.
18.why: 对每个人友好，B「善良是通往自己幸福的桥」，后面说别人会回报你。

19.ev: Different kinds of activities like playing football can help you to be known to others.
19.why: 这一条讲参加各种活动，小标题 A「积极参加集体活动」。

20.ev: It makes a good first impression.
20.why: 乐观给人好印象，C「愉快的微笑花得最少、作用最大」，后面说幽默也吸引人。

articles.src: 2025年鹤壁市外国语中学中原名校联盟中考一模
articles.title: To celebrate the Year of the Snake, Shanghai offers lots of
body: To celebrate the Year of the Snake, Shanghai offers lots of great events.

Shanghai Romance Park hosts Chinese New Year Carnival (嘉年华) At Shanghai Romance Park, you can experience a cultural party filled with intangible heritage (非物质文化遗产) activities and a family-friendly carnival celebrating the Chinese New Year.Date: Jan. 29 to Feb. 4 Place: Shanghai Romance Park, 1750 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area   Yuyuan Garden Lantern Festival Enjoy the Lantern Festival in Yuyuan Garden. Its theme is about the Year of the Snake. There are lanterns in shapes of snakes, butterflies and other forest insects. It’s also a celebration of nature and tradition.Date: Jan. 1 to Feb. 12 Place: Yuyuan Garden, 168 Fuyou Road, Huangpu District (区)

Rockbund Chinese New Year Market Come to the Rockbund Chinese New Year Market and enjoy delicious Chinese foods, admire beautiful tea sets, and look through ancient books for an unforgettable celebration.Date: Jan. 10 to Feb. 16 Place: Yuanmingyuan Road, Pedestrian Street   Shanghai Disneyland’ s Celebrations Join the magical activities at Shanghai Disneyland, where the Year of the Snake is celebrated with different kinds of exciting activities. Make unforgettable memories at this amazing place during the Chinese New Year period.Date: Jan. 28 to Feb. 14 Place: Shanghai Disney Park, 310 Huangzhao Road, Pudong New Area

qs.stem: Where is Shanghai Romance Park?
opts: It’s at 168 Fuyou Road, Huangpu District.
It’s at 1750 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area.
It’s on Yuanmingyuan Road, Pedestrian Street.
It’s at 310 Huangzhao Road, Pudong New Area.

ex.ev: Place: Shanghai Romance Park, 1750 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area
ex.why: 上海浪漫乐园在浦东新区世博大道 1750 号。

qs.stem: What is special about the Lantern Festival in Yuyuan Garden?
opts: It has a family-friendly carnival celebrating the Chinese New Year.
It offers delicious Chinese foods and beautiful tea sets.
It provides different kinds of exciting activities.
It shows lanterns in shapes of snakes and forest insects.

ex.ev: There are lanterns in shapes of snakes, butterflies and other forest insects.
ex.why: 豫园灯会有蛇、蝴蝶等森林昆虫形状的灯。

qs.stem: When can you enjoy the celebrations for the Year of the Snake held in Shanghai Disneyland?

ex.ev: Date: Jan. 28 to Feb. 14 Place: Shanghai Disney Park
ex.why: 迪士尼的活动是 1 月 28 日到 2 月 14 日，四个选项里只有 2 月 1 日在这段时间内。

qs.stem: If Mr. Smith wants to read ancient Chinese books, where should he go?
opts: To the Rockbund Chinese New Year Market.

ex.ev: admire beautiful tea sets, and look through ancient books
ex.why: 外滩源新年集市可以翻看古书。

qs.stem: In which part of a website can we probably read the text?

ex.ev: To celebrate the Year of the Snake, Shanghai offers lots of great events.
ex.why: 介绍上海春节期间的新活动，最可能放在网站的「新鲜事」栏目。

cand: adj. 文化的；与文化有关的
adj. 无形的；难以衡量的

articles.src: 2025年鹤壁市外国语中学中原名校联盟中考一模
articles.title: We often hear the saying “Like father, like son.
body: We often hear the saying “Like father, like son.” Kids are often like their parents. They might look the same, act the same and enjoy the same things. This might be because kids learn from their parents. More importantly, they carry genes (基因) from their parents.
There are about 30,000 genes in your body. They make you YOU! You get some genes from your mom and some from your dad. They decide things like your hair color, eye color and how tall you can be!

Sometimes, genes do not show up in your parents. But they show up in you. For example, your parents have double eyelids (眼皮), but you have single eyelids. That’s because both of your parents have single-eyelid genes. When they pass down the genes to you, these genes show up in you.
Every one of us is a fun mix of our parents. But what interesting genes do we get from our mom, and what do we get from our dad?
How smart are you?
Get more from: Mom

Some genes decide how smart we are. Women have two sets of these genes, while men have one. So, kids are more likely to get their smart brains from their moms. But being smart is only partly because of genes. What you learn also plays a big role.
Are you good at sports?
Get more from: Mom
We get some genes only from our moms. These genes influence how good we are at sports. For example, one gene helps our muscles (肌肉) use oxygen better. If your mom is good at sports, you might be too!
Do you get fat easily?
Get more from: Dad

Our body has good fat and bad fat. The good fat keeps us healthy. The bad fat makes us overweight. How much bad fat do you have? Your dad’s genes have a bigger say. But it is not all about genes. Eating a lot and moving less also make you get fat easily.

qs.stem: How does the writer lead into the topic in Paragraph 1?

ex.ev: We often hear the saying “Like father, like son.”
ex.why: 第一段用一句俗语「有其父必有其子」引出话题。

qs.stem: What do we know from Paragraph 2?
opts: The genes we get from our parents decide our appearance.
We get more genes from our mother.
There are about 3,000 genes in our body.
Our weight has nothing to do with our parents.

ex.ev: They decide things like your hair color, eye color and how tall you can be!
ex.why: 从父母那里得到的基因决定头发颜色、眼睛颜色、身高——决定我们的外貌。基因约 3 万个，不是 3000。

qs.stem: If you are good at sports, it’s probably because ________.
opts: you have two sets of genes of sports
your mom is good at sports
your dad is good at sports
you move a lot and eat less

ex.ev: If your mom is good at sports, you might be too!
ex.why: 运动方面的基因只来自妈妈：妈妈擅长运动，你可能也擅长。

qs.stem: What do the underlined words “have a bigger say” mean in the text?

ex.ev: How much bad fat do you have? Your dad’s genes have a bigger say.
ex.why: 你有多少坏脂肪，爸爸的基因说了算——have a bigger say 是「影响更大」。

qs.stem: What is the writer’s purpose in writing the text?
opts: To explain what makes you YOU.
To tell us what genes are.
To discuss how smart genes are.
To show the importance of genes.

ex.ev: They make you YOU!
ex.why: 全文讲你从爸妈那里得到哪些基因，是这些基因让你成为你——解释是什么造就了你。

articles.src: 2025年开封市中考一模
articles.title: Do you feel bored with the coming May Day holiday?
body: Do you feel bored with the coming May Day holiday? A lot of teens don’t know what interesting things to do except doing homework. Some may spend lots of time playing computer games. We asked parents for ideas for things that teens can do and here are some suggestions for fun activities for you to do during the holiday.

#1 ________ Visit older family members and interview them about the past of your family. You could use a smartphone to record some of the conversation. Things to ask about:·What did you eat? ·Who was your favorite family member? ·What did you do to make yourself happy? ·What was it like when you were a teenager?

#2 ________ Not only will you make your parents really happy, but you will find all those lost CDs/ books/socks that are hidden under the bed. You can now have a yard sale for the things you no longer want and make yourself some pocket money at the same time.

#3 ________ Put together a memory book. It could be about primary or junior school since you’re heading to high school:·friends made ·best memories ·favorite teachers ·favorite subjects hopes/feelings about going to high school, etc.

#4 ________ Get down and work on the farm and have a bit of fun. You never know you might love driving tractors and feeding cows and horses. If nothing else, it will give you a good taste of what a hard life farming is.

qs.stem: What is one of the suggestions for teens during the holiday?
opts: Interview older family members about family history.
Write a novel about their school life.

ex.ev: Visit older family members and interview them about the past of your family.
ex.why: 建议之一：拜访家里的长辈，采访他们家里过去的事。

qs.stem: What can you do with the things you no longer want?
opts: Give them to strangers for free.
Have a yard sale to make some money.
Hide them deeper under the bed.

ex.ev: You can now have a yard sale for the things you no longer want and make yourself some pocket money at the same time.
ex.why: 不要的东西可以在院子里卖掉，还能赚点零花钱。

qs.stem: What is the proper title for #1, #2, #3 and #4 separately? a. Clear out Your Room              b. Create a Memory Book c. Help on a Nearby Farm              d. Discover Family History

ex.why: #1 采访长辈了解家史（d），#2 收拾房间（a），#3 做回忆册（b），#4 去农场帮忙（c）。

qs.stem: What might you experience on the farm according to the passage?
opts: Driving tractors and feeding cows and horses.

ex.ev: You never know you might love driving tractors and feeding cows and horses.
ex.why: 在农场可能开拖拉机、喂牛喂马。

qs.stem: Why do we do these activities according to the passage?
opts: To feel bored during the holiday.
To kill time by playing computer games.
To have fun during the holiday.

ex.ev: here are some suggestions for fun activities for you to do during the holiday.
ex.why: 这些活动是为了让假期过得有趣。

cand: n. 十三至十九岁青少年

articles.src: 2025年开封市中考一模
articles.title: Cui Chenxi is a seventh grader in a middle school in Shenyang.
body: Cui Chenxi is a seventh grader in a middle school in Shenyang. When he was preparing lessons before class, he noticed a mistake on a page of the English textbook. In one of the pictures, there is a hoverfly (食蚜蝇), and there is a word under the picture to describe it. The word is “bee”.

Cui reported the mix-up of two insects to the textbook’s publisher (出版商) and quickly got a reply. The publisher confirmed (确认) the mistake after asking a biology teacher. They said they would correct the mistake by replacing the wrong picture in a reprinted version (版本). Besides, the publisher thanked the 12-year-old boy for reporting the mistake, and praised him for being “really professional”.

When asked how he discovered the mistake, Cui said, “It’s simple. Bees have two pairs of wings while hoverflies have only one pair. Bees are fat with their round bellies and hoverflies are thin. What’s more, bees’ tentacles (触须) are clear to see while those of hoverflies are obscure.”
According to Cui’s mother, the boy shows a great interest in biology. He raised 10 types of ants in his primary school days in order to find out the insects’ habits and how their work is divided.

The family keeps hundreds of books about natural science. And Cui has a bookshelf of his own. Thanks to his parents, Cui doesn’t need to take after-school training classes. He’s happy to learn what he loves.
[图:reading/6517357c/image1.png]

qs.stem: What did Cui find while preparing the lessons before class?
opts: The picture of a hoverfly was mistaken for a bee.
The English teacher read the word hoverfly incorrectly.
One page of his English textbook was lost.
There is a picture of a bee in his English textbook.

ex.ev: In one of the pictures, there is a hoverfly (食蚜蝇), and there is a word under the picture to describe it. The word is “bee”.
ex.why: 图里画的是食蚜蝇，下面却写着「蜜蜂」——把食蚜蝇错当成了蜜蜂。

qs.stem: What does the second paragraph mainly talk about?
opts: It’s about what Cui asked the publisher to do.
It’s about what Cui did after discovering the mistake.
It’s about what the publisher learned from the mistake.
It’s about what the publisher did after receiving Cui’s report.

ex.ev: The publisher confirmed (确认) the mistake after asking a biology teacher.
ex.why: 第二段讲出版社收到他的报告后做了什么：确认错误、答应改正、感谢表扬他。

qs.stem: What does the underlined word “obscure” mean in Chinese?

ex.ev: bees’ tentacles (触须) are clear to see while those of hoverflies are obscure.
ex.why: 蜜蜂的触须看得清楚，食蚜蝇的则……——obscure 是「模糊的」。

qs.stem: Why did Cui study the ants?
opts: Because he often puts ideas into practice.

ex.ev: According to Cui’s mother, the boy shows a great interest in biology.
ex.why: 他对生物很感兴趣，所以小学时养了 10 种蚂蚁来研究。

qs.stem: What’s the purpose of the passage?
opts: To encourage students to read books about nature.
To tell the differences between bees and hoverflies.
To ask students to pay more attention to their textbooks.
To introduce a boy who found a mistake in the textbook.

ex.ev: When he was preparing lessons before class, he noticed a mistake on a page of the English textbook.
ex.why: 全文介绍一个发现课本错误的男孩。

cand: n. 书架；书橱中的搁板

articles.src: 2025年开封市中考一模
articles.title: Dancing is good for health.
body: Dancing is good for health. Moving our bodies helps us relax and forget our problems. A lot of people take up dancing as a hobby after school. In fact, dancing has been considered one of the best exercises to fight bad feelings in recent years.
Dancing, which involves (包含) moving the body to different kinds of music, helps our bodies produce much endorphin (内啡肽), a chemical (化学物质) that makes us feel relaxed and happy.

While simply listening to music or doing sports can cheer us up, mixing them together gives better results. In a study, a group of German scientists tested some patients under three conditions：a group dancing to music, a group just listening to music , and a group riding bikes without music. The results showed that the first group were the least depressed (沮丧的).

Dancing can bring people together, too. Tango, Latin or other social dancing require us to move with others, which can improve our sense of social bonding (联系), according to IBSA, a Swiss scientific foundation.

Dancing also helps people let go of bad feelings. Studies have found that depression often has to do with sadness about the past or worries about the future. However, dancing helps you focus on the present, connect with your body, and free your mind for a while, as reported by Psych Central, a mental health news website.

Lauren Helper, a social worker in Virginia, US, pointed out that if people enjoy music of any kind, dancing can be a helpful way to reduce (减轻) stress. She also said that dancing can take any form, whether it’s moving around the house to a song or going out dancing with friends. “The important part of movement is that it is fun,” she told Psych Central.

qs.stem: Why do a lot of people like dancing after school? a. Because dancing is a good way to fight bad feelings. b. Because dancing can make people eat more. c. Because dancing makes people relaxed and happy. d. Because dancing can make people sleep longer.

ex.ev: In fact, dancing has been considered one of the best exercises to fight bad feelings in recent years.
ex.why: 跳舞能对抗坏情绪（a），还能让人放松快乐（c）——ac。

qs.stem: What is the result of the test done by German scientists?
opts: Listening to music can make people forget problems.
People dancing to music are the least depressed.
Don’t listen to music while riding bikes.
Simply listening to music can’t cheer us up.

ex.ev: The results showed that the first group were the least depressed (沮丧的).
ex.why: 随音乐跳舞的那组人最不沮丧。

qs.stem: What matters most when we move, according to Lauren Helper?

ex.ev: “The important part of movement is that it is fun,”
ex.why: 她说运动最重要的是开心有趣。

qs.stem: What is the structure of the passage?

ex.why: ①总起「跳舞有益健康」，②到⑥分别讲各种好处和专家看法，是并列关系——D 图。

qs.stem: How does the writer develop his ideas?
opts: By showing study results and opinions.
By listing different kinds of music.

ex.ev: In a study, a group of German scientists tested some patients under three conditions
ex.why: 作者用研究结果（德国科学家的实验）和专家观点来说明。

articles.src: 2025年焦作市中考一模
articles.title: Welcome to the Science Festival!
body: Welcome to the Science Festival! Are you interested in inventions? If so, please join in the 2025 Science Festival in our school.  During the festival, you’re encouraged to bring and introduce your inventions to teachers and students. Of course you can also learn about interesting and useful inventions created by other students. What are you waiting for? The theme of the 2025 Science Festival is “Inventions Make Our Life More Comfortable”.
Schedule(时间表)
The Science Festival dates   April 1st—7th   Students and teachers can go to the school library to enjoy different inventions.
Application deadline (申请截止日期)   March 25th   Students who have invented something can apply to (申请) take part in the festival.
Requirements:
Your invention needs to be created by yourself or your team.
▶Your invention should be useful in daily life.
Prizes:
Teachers and students will vote (投票) for their favorite inventions. The first prize will be a certificate (证书) and 100 yuan.
The second prize will be a certificate and 50 yuan. Every inventor will receive a book as a special gift.
Come and show your creativity!

qs.stem: What is the festival mainly about?

ex.ev: Are you interested in inventions? If so, please join in the 2025 Science Festival in our school.
ex.why: 科技节主要是关于发明的。

qs.stem: How long will the festival last?

ex.ev: The Science Festival dates   April 1st—7th
ex.why: 4 月 1 日到 7 日，一周。

qs.stem: Which of the following is TRUE?
opts: The winners must be voted by teachers.
The festival will be held on the school playground.
Students can apply to take part in the festival if they have invention works.
The inventions should be useful and created only by the inventors alone.

ex.ev: Students who have invented something can apply to (申请) take part in the festival.
ex.why: 有发明的学生可以申请参加。投票的是师生两方；地点是图书馆；可以个人或团队完成。

qs.stem: Who will get a book as a special gift?
opts: The winner of the first prize.
The winner of the second prize.

ex.ev: Every inventor will receive a book as a special gift.
ex.why: 每个发明者都会得到一本书作特别礼物。

qs.stem: Where can we probably read the text?

ex.ev: please join in the 2025 Science Festival in our school.
ex.why: 学校科技节的通知，最可能贴在学校公告栏上。

articles.src: 2025年焦作市中考一模
articles.title: These days, more and more South Koreans are flying to Shangh
body: These days, more and more South Koreans are flying to Shanghai for weekend trips without a visa ( 签 证). The visa-free policy allows South Koreans to stay in China for up to 30 days.     36

Koreans can be seen taking photos at places like the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower, Nanjing Road, Yu Garden, and Shanghai Disneyland.     37     Haidilao, a famous hotpot restaurant, is well-known for its free snacks and excellent service. It is very popular among the South Korean tourists.

Flights from Jeju Island to Shanghai Pudong are cheap, costing only 300 yuan or more, and the trip takes just 90 minutes.     38     There are more than 200 round-trip (往返旅程) flights each week between Shanghai and Seoul in December. This does not include flights from Busan, Jeju Island, and other cities to Shanghai.

39     Young tourists enjoy busy cities like Shanghai. They can experience Chinese and Western cultures together there.     40     Elderly tourists often go to beautiful places like Zhangjiajie in Hunan Province and Jiuzhaigou in Sichuan Province. The splendid   sceneries (壮丽的景色) are unforgettable for them.

opts: This makes the travel very fast and easy.
These places are popular on social media.
They also like Qingdao for its beauty and delicious seafood.
It is easier for them to visit different places of interest in China.
South Korean tourists of different ages like different places in China.

36.ev: The visa-free policy allows South Koreans to stay in China for up to 30 days.
36.why: 免签能在中国待 30 天，D「他们去中国各地的景点更方便了」。

37.ev: Koreans can be seen taking photos at places like the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower, Nanjing Road, Yu Garden, and Shanghai Disneyland.
37.why: 在外滩、东方明珠等地拍照，B「这些地方在社交媒体上很火」。

38.ev: Flights from Jeju Island to Shanghai Pudong are cheap, costing only 300 yuan or more, and the trip takes just 90 minutes.
38.why: 机票便宜、只要 90 分钟，A「这让旅行又快又方便」。

39.ev: Young tourists enjoy busy cities like Shanghai.
39.why: 后面说年轻人喜欢上海、老年人喜欢张家界，前面应是 E「不同年龄的韩国游客喜欢中国不同的地方」。

40.ev: They can experience Chinese and Western cultures together there.
40.why: 还在说年轻人，C「他们也喜欢青岛的美景和海鲜」，后面才转到老年人。

articles.src: 2025年许昌市中考一模
articles.title: Careless mistakes can not be completely avoided.
body: Careless mistakes can not be completely avoided. Some might think they are just about being careless. But when we look closer, we can find that these mistakes actually show how we think. They show deeper patterns (方式) in our mind. Fixing them isn’t just about trying harder, it’s about changing how we learn and solve problems.

One way to help is by keeping a “mistake notebook.” In this notebook, we write down the mistakes we make, like reading instructions wrongly, misunderstanding logic (逻辑), or working out numbers incorrectly. By doing this, we can see patterns in our mistakes and learn from them instead of feeling bad about them.

Another good idea is to make lists for different subjects. For math, we can write down steps like checking our answers. For writing, we can review our papers and look for grammar mistakes. These lists are like little helpers that guide us through our work and help us make fewer mistakes.
Taking breaks is important too. When we feel nervous, we should take a deep breath, think about how to deal with the problem, slow down. This helps us catch mistakes before they happen.
And, it’s really important to celebrate when we make progress, even if it’s just a little bit. This makes us feel good about ourselves and keeps us focused on getting better.
So, to fix careless mistakes, we need to change how we think and use some helpful tools. By doing these things, we can make fewer mistakes and learn more.

qs.stem: Which of the following mistakes might NOT be found in a “mistake notebook”?

ex.ev: like reading instructions wrongly, misunderstanding logic (逻辑), or working out numbers incorrectly.
ex.why: 错题本记的是读错要求、逻辑理解错、算错数，没有团队里做错决定。

qs.stem: What is the use of making lists for different subjects according to paragraph 3?
opts: Showing us the importance of doing homework.
Guiding us through our work and reduce mistakes.
Helping us catch mistakes before they happen.
Keeping us focused on getting better.

ex.ev: These lists are like little helpers that guide us through our work and help us make fewer mistakes.
ex.why: 清单像小帮手，带我们完成作业、少犯错误。

qs.stem: What are the correct ways to relax when you feel nervous according to the text? ①deep breath ②listen to music ③ talk to someone ④slow down ⑤think ⑥ play outside

ex.ev: When we feel nervous, we should take a deep breath, think about how to deal with the problem, slow down.
ex.why: 紧张时：深呼吸（①）、想想怎么办（⑤）、放慢（④）——①④⑤。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be put in the mind map? [图:reading/6bc49bcf/image11.png]

ex.ev: And, it’s really important to celebrate when we make progress, even if it’s just a little bit.
ex.why: 思维导图里有错题本、列清单、休息，第四个方法是庆祝进步。

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the writer in writing this passage?
opts: To give tips on how to make fewer mistakes.
To advise readers not to make mistakes.
To explain why we make careless mistakes.
To show the bad influence of making mistakes.

ex.ev: So, to fix careless mistakes, we need to change how we think and use some helpful tools.
ex.why: 全文给出减少粗心错误的方法。

articles.src: 2025年南阳市第十三中学中考三模
articles.title: On December 4, 2024, the UNESCO (联合国教科文组织) added the Spring
body: On December 4, 2024, the UNESCO (联合国教科文组织) added the Spring Festival to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity (《人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录》).     16

The Spring Festival, also known as Chinese New Year, is one of the most important festivals in China. The Spring Festival is all about family.     17     During the Spring Festival, many people will return to their hometowns from different places and get together with their family. Celebrations for the Spring Festival last for 15 days and always end with the Lantern Festival.

18     It is said that people celebrate at a time when they try to drive away a monster (怪物) by using the red color and setting off fireworks. Red is a symbol of being lucky, peaceful and wealthy. Houses and streets outside have been filled with red silk banners (横幅) and messages of goodwill. Fireworks bring new hope for the future.     19     On New Year’s Eve, people eat dumplings, fish, meatballs and rice cakes for dinner.
Apart from these traditions, many other traditions, such as paper cutting and dragon dance, are also celebrated in China and some Asian countries.     20     They also bring good memories for people.

opts: They create the happiest days for people.
And they can also keep off the bad luck from the past year.
There is a traditional Chinese story about the Spring Festival.
In China, people have deep feelings for their family members.
China now has 44 things on the intangible cultural heritage list.

16.ev: added the Spring Festival to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
16.why: 春节被列入非遗名录，E「中国现在有 44 项列入名录」接着说。

17.ev: The Spring Festival is all about family.
17.why: 春节就是关于家庭的，D「在中国人们对家人感情很深」，后面说大家回家团聚。

18.ev: It is said that people celebrate at a time when they try to drive away a monster (怪物) by using the red color and setting off fireworks.
18.why: 后面说「据说人们用红色和鞭炮赶走怪兽」，前面应是 C「关于春节有一个传统故事」。

19.ev: Fireworks bring new hope for the future.
19.why: 鞭炮带来新希望，B「也能赶走过去一年的坏运气」。

20.ev: They also bring good memories for people.
20.why: 后面说「它们还给人们带来美好回忆」，前面应是 A「它们给人们创造了最快乐的日子」。

articles.src: 2025年郑州外国语中学中考三模
articles.title: Weekends, air conditioners (空调), takeouts… are all common th
body: Weekends, air conditioners (空调), takeouts… are all common things for modern people. Have you ever wondered if ancient people enjoyed the same lifestyles? Let’s take a look.

No weekends In ancient China, there were no weekends because people did not use a weekly calendar. But they could still relax after work. During the Han Dynasty, officers took one day off every five days. During the Tang Dynasty, officers worked for ten days and rested for one day. There were also many public holidays in ancient times, such as Spring Festival, winter solstice and Mid-Autumn Festival. People like farmers and businessmen usually worked most of the year, but even the most hard-working people would take a few days off during Spring Festival.

Smart ways of staying cool In ancient times, though people didn’t have air conditioners, they had their own ways to get through the hot summer. People collected ice blocks in winter and stored them in an icehouse. When summer came, people could take the ice blocks home and use them to make their rooms cooler. There was a kind of pillow (枕头) made of porcelain (瓷器) that felt pleasantly cool. Ancient people also made bamboo into bed mats (垫子) to sleep on. They’re still used today.

Takeouts not a new thing There was takeout as far back as the Song Dynasty. In the famous Song Dynasty painting Along the River During the Qingming Festival (《清明上河图》), a takeout worker can be seen with food in hand. People at the time even had special meal boxes for takeout dishes. They also used warming plates made of two layers (层) of porcelain. Hot water could be put between them to keep dishes warm.

qs.stem: Why were there no weekends in ancient times?
opts: Because ancient people were more hard-working than modern ones.
Because ancient people didn’t use a weekly calendar.
Because the emperors didn’t allow their people to have a rest.
Because ancient people wanted to make more money.

ex.ev: In ancient China, there were no weekends because people did not use a weekly calendar.
ex.why: 古代没有周末，是因为不用以星期计时的日历。

qs.stem: How many ways are mentioned to stay cool in ancient China in the passage?

ex.ev: People collected ice blocks in winter and stored them in an icehouse.
ex.why: 古人消暑的办法：冰块、瓷枕、竹席，共三种。

qs.stem: How did people in ancient times keep takeout dishes warm?
opts: They put hot water between plates.
They lit candles under the dishes.
They covered the dishes with thick cloth.
They walked fast to deliver (送) the dishes.

ex.ev: Hot water could be put between them to keep dishes warm.
ex.why: 在两层瓷盘之间倒热水，给外卖保温。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is TRUE?
opts: In ancient China, people like farmers and businessmen worked all year round.
Ancient people used bed mats made of silk to stay cool.
Along the River During the Qingming Festival was painted in Song Dynasty.
Modern people still have the same lifestyles as ancient people.

ex.ev: In the famous Song Dynasty painting Along the River During the Qingming Festival (《清明上河图》),
ex.why: 《清明上河图》是宋代的画。农民商人春节也会休息；竹席是竹子做的，不是丝绸。

qs.stem: Where can we read this passage probably?

ex.ev: Have you ever wondered if ancient people enjoyed the same lifestyles? Let’s take a look.
ex.why: 介绍古人的生活方式（休假、消暑、外卖），最可能登在历史杂志上。

articles.src: 2025年郑州外国语中学中考三模
articles.title: Daily newspapers in Britain and the United States Newspapers
body: Daily newspapers in Britain and the United States
Newspapers in Britain can be divided into the quality newspapers (more serious newspapers) and the popular newspapers.
Quality newspapers are for readers who want full information on public things.     16     They also carry sports, cultural events, travel news and book reviews.
17     People who want funny news prefer reading them. They have large headlines(标题), a lot of big photos, and news about famous people.

The Times is the most famous of the quality newspapers. It began in 1785.     18     The Sun, founded in 1964, is the most successful of the popular newspapers. It sells more than any other daily newspaper.     19

In the United States, you can find the quality newspapers like The New York Times and The Washington Post.     20     You can buy the bigger ones all over the country. The US also has a lot of tabloids, such as The New York Daily News, which are similar to British tabloids.

opts: Around four million people read it every day.
Popular newspapers are also known as tabloids (小报).
They usually have the name of the city where they are produced.
They have home and international news, and financial (金融的) reports.
It is read by important people such as officers, lawyers and businessmen.

16.ev: They also carry sports, cultural events, travel news and book reviews.

articles.title: Whether it’s a sports match or a bike race with your friends
body: Whether it’s a sports match or a bike race with your friends, no one wins every time. Things don’t always turn out the way you want and losing is a part of life. Losing can be disappointing and sad. However, learning to lose well can turn these feelings around and help you succeed next time.     36
Manage your feelings

It’s natural to feel disappointed when you lose.     37     For example, take a deep breath, draw or go for a walk. Try to find the humor in what has happened, and keep a smile on your face—even though it may be hard for you to give a natural smile.
Lose with grace (体面)

Try to be happy for others when they win.     38     If others judge you for losing, let them do so. You know who you are, and you don’t need to explain yourself to someone else who doesn’t know your heart. Be your own center.
Try to learn from what happened
Try to think about what happened. Did you practice well for the match? Did your team communicate well? Find out what you can do to stop this from happening again.     39
Keep playing the game

No matter what led to your failure, make sure that you don’t let it stop you from doing what you love. Most people have to face failure—including winners.     40     You may regret it later if you give up because of failure.

opts: Find ways to cheer yourself up.
Shake hands with them, and say“well done”.
These following tips might help you with it.
Pay attention to the future and do better next time.
You’ll never make progress if you don’t keep trying.

36.ev: However, learning to lose well can turn these feelings around and help you succeed next time.
36.why: 学会好好面对失败很重要，C「下面这些建议可能对你有帮助」引出几条建议。

37.ev: For example, take a deep breath, draw or go for a walk.
37.why: 后面举例深呼吸、画画、散步，前面应是 A「想办法让自己振作起来」。

38.ev: Try to be happy for others when they win.
38.why: 为赢的人高兴，B「和他们握手，说声“干得好”」。

39.ev: Find out what you can do to stop this from happening again.
39.why: 想想怎样避免再输，D「关注将来，下次做得更好」。

40.ev: You may regret it later if you give up because of failure.
40.why: 别因失败放弃喜欢的事，E「不坚持就永远不会进步」。

articles.title: My cousins were raised in a rich family.
body: My cousins were raised in a rich family. They lived in a fancy (豪华) house with a beautiful pool. But my cousins didn’t think they were better than anyone else, even though they were rich. The reason was that my Uncle John and Aunt Kate made sure they were not spoiled (溺爱) with gifts. The pool was a perfect example of this.
One day in the summer, my cousins were bored and hot, so they said to my Uncle John, “Dad, we’re the only kids in this community that don’t have a pool. Can we have one? ”
“Of course you can! ” agreed their father. “A pool it is! It will be started tomorrow. ” The kids were surprised to see how agreeable their dad was.

Early the next day, my uncle woke up everyone and brought them downstairs. “Come on outside. I have a surprise for you! ” he said. “Close your eyes.” They did, and he led them to the backyard. “Now hold out your hands, ” he said. When they opened their eyes, each of them had been presented with a new shovel.
A look of surprise came over their faces. Then, their dad said with a smile, “You can have a pool, but you’re going to have to dig it! ”

At first, the digging went slowly. They were tired every day. But as the week passed, they began to see their work take shape. After ten days, they had the pool completely dug out. Then, the workers came and finished the rest of the work. In another week, they had a finished pool. And best of all, they had helped make it!
Years later, one of my cousins said to me, “I never asked my dad if I could borrow the car because I was afraid I’d have to build it myself! ”

qs.stem: Why does the writer give the example of the pool?
opts: To show his cousins were raised in a rich family.
To show his cousins were not spoiled.

opts: Children should do what parents tell them to do.
